StreamPeerTCP.brief_description: A stream peer that handles TCP connections.
StreamPeerTCP.description:
A stream peer that handles TCP connections. This object can be used to connect to TCP servers, or also is returned by a TCP server.
		Note: When exporting to Android, make sure to enable the INTERNET permission in the Android export preset before exporting the project or using one-click deploy. Otherwise, network communication of any kind will be blocked by Android.

bind.description:
Opens the TCP socket, and binds it to the specified local address.
				This method is generally not needed, and only used to force the subsequent call to connect_to_host to use the specified host and port as source address. This can be desired in some NAT punchthrough techniques, or when forcing the source network interface.

connect_to_host.description: Connects to the specified host:port pair. A hostname will be resolved if valid. Returns  on success.

get_connected_host.description: Returns the IP of this peer.

get_connected_port.description: Returns the port of this peer.

get_local_port.description: Returns the local port to which this peer is bound.

set_no_delay.description:
If enabled is true, packets will be sent immediately. If enabled is false (the default), packet transfers will be delayed and combined using Nagle's algorithm.
				Note: It's recommended to leave this disabled for applications that send large packets or need to transfer a lot of data, as enabling this can decrease the total available bandwidth.

StreamPeerTLS.brief_description: A stream peer that handles TLS connections.
StreamPeerTLS.description:
A stream peer that handles TLS connections. This object can be used to connect to a TLS server or accept a single TLS client connection.
		Note: When exporting to Android, make sure to enable the INTERNET permission in the Android export preset before exporting the project or using one-click deploy. Otherwise, network communication of any kind will be blocked by Android.

poll.description: Poll the connection to check for incoming bytes. Call this right before StreamPeer.get_available_bytes for it to work properly.

accept_stream.description: Accepts a peer connection as a server using the given server_options. See TLSOptions.server.

connect_to_stream.description: Connects to a peer using an underlying  stream and verifying the remote certificate is correctly signed for the given common_name. You can pass the optional client_options parameter to customize the trusted certification authorities, or disable the common name verification. See TLSOptions.client and TLSOptions.client_unsafe.

get_status.description: Returns the status of the connection.

get_stream.description: Returns the underlying  connection, used in accept_stream or connect_to_stream.

StreamPeerUDS.brief_description: A stream peer that handles UNIX Domain Socket (UDS) connections.
StreamPeerUDS.description:
A stream peer that handles UNIX Domain Socket (UDS) connections. This object can be used to connect to UDS servers, or also is returned by a UDS server. Unix Domain Sockets provide inter-process communication on the same machine using the filesystem namespace.
		Note: UNIX Domain Sockets are only available on UNIX-like systems (Linux, macOS, etc.) and are not supported on Windows.

bind.description:
Opens the UDS socket, and binds it to the specified socket path.
				This method is generally not needed, and only used to force the subsequent call to connect_to_host to use the specified path as the source address.

connect_to_host.description: Connects to the specified UNIX Domain Socket path. Returns  on success.

get_connected_path.description: Returns the socket path of this peer.

StyleBox.brief_description: Abstract base class for defining stylized boxes for UI elements.
StyleBox.description:
is an abstract base class for drawing stylized boxes for UI elements. It is used for panels, buttons,  backgrounds,  backgrounds, etc. and also for testing a transparency mask for pointer signals. If mask test fails on a  assigned as mask to a control, clicks and motion signals will go through it to the one below.
		Note: For control nodes that have Theme Properties, the focus  is displayed over the normal, hover or pressed . This makes the focus  more reusable across different nodes.

_get_minimum_size.description: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. Returns a custom minimum size that the stylebox must respect when drawing. By default get_minimum_size only takes content margins into account. This method can be overridden to add another size restriction. A combination of the default behavior and the output of this method will be used, to account for both sizes.

get_minimum_size.description: Returns the minimum size that this stylebox can be shrunk to.

set_content_margin.description: Sets the default value of the specified  to offset pixels.

set_content_margin_all.description: Sets the default margin to offset pixels for all sides.

get_content_margin.description: Returns the default margin of the specified .

get_margin.description:
Returns the content margin offset for the specified .
				Positive values reduce size inwards, unlike 's margin values.

get_offset.description: Returns the "offset" of a stylebox. This helper function returns a value equivalent to Vector2(style.get_margin(MARGIN_LEFT), style.get_margin(MARGIN_TOP)).

draw.description:
Draws this stylebox using a canvas item identified by the given .
				The  value can either be the result of CanvasItem.get_canvas_item called on an existing -derived node, or directly from creating a canvas item in the  with RenderingServer.canvas_item_create.

get_current_item_drawn.description: Returns the  that handles its  or CanvasItem._draw callback at this moment.

test_mask.description: Test a position in a rectangle, return whether it passes the mask test.

content_margin_left.description:
The left margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the left.
			Refer to content_margin_bottom for extra considerations.

content_margin_top.description:
The top margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the top.
			Refer to content_margin_bottom for extra considerations.

content_margin_right.description:
The right margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the right.
			Refer to content_margin_bottom for extra considerations.

content_margin_bottom.description:
The bottom margin for the contents of this style box. Increasing this value reduces the space available to the contents from the bottom.
			If this value is negative, it is ignored and a child-specific margin is used instead. For example, for , the border thickness (if any) is used instead.
			It is up to the code using this style box to decide what these contents are: for example, a  respects this content margin for the textual contents of the button.
			get_margin should be used to fetch this value as consumer instead of reading these properties directly. This is because it correctly respects negative values and the fallback mentioned above.

StyleBoxEmpty.description: An empty  that can be used to display nothing instead of the default style (e.g. it can "disable" focus styles).

StyleBoxFlat.brief_description: A customizable  that doesn't use a texture.
StyleBoxFlat.description:
By configuring various properties of this style box, you can achieve many common looks without the need of a texture. This includes optionally rounded borders, antialiasing, shadows, and skew.
		Setting corner radius to high values is allowed. As soon as corners overlap, the stylebox will switch to a relative system:
		
		height = 30
		corner_radius_top_left = 50
		corner_radius_bottom_left = 100
		
		The relative system now would take the 1:2 ratio of the two left corners to calculate the actual corner width. Both corners added will never be more than the height. Result:
		
		corner_radius_top_left: 10
		corner_radius_bottom_left: 20

set_border_width_all.description: Sets the border width to width pixels for all sides.

get_border_width_min.description: Returns the smallest border width out of all four borders.

set_border_width.description: Sets the specified 's border width to width pixels.

set_corner_radius_all.description: Sets the corner radius to radius pixels for all corners.

set_corner_radius.description: Sets the corner radius to radius pixels for the given corner.

set_expand_margin.description: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for the specified .

set_expand_margin_all.description: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for all sides.

get_expand_margin.description: Returns the size of the specified 's expand margin.

bg_color.description: The background color of the stylebox.

draw_center.description: Toggles drawing of the inner part of the stylebox.

skew.description:
If set to a non-zero value on either axis, skew distorts the StyleBox horizontally and/or vertically. This can be used for "futuristic"-style UIs. Positive values skew the StyleBox towards the right (X axis) and upwards (Y axis), while negative values skew the StyleBox towards the left (X axis) and downwards (Y axis).
			Note: To ensure text does not touch the StyleBox's edges, consider increasing the 's content margin (see StyleBox.content_margin_bottom). It is preferable to increase the content margin instead of the expand margin (see expand_margin_bottom), as increasing the expand margin does not increase the size of the clickable area for s.

border_width_left.description: Border width for the left border.

border_width_top.description: Border width for the top border.

border_width_right.description: Border width for the right border.

border_width_bottom.description: Border width for the bottom border.

border_color.description: Sets the color of the border.

border_blend.description: If true, the border will fade into the background color.

corner_radius_top_left.description: The top-left corner's radius. If 0, the corner is not rounded.

corner_radius_top_right.description: The top-right corner's radius. If 0, the corner is not rounded.

corner_radius_bottom_right.description: The bottom-right corner's radius. If 0, the corner is not rounded.

corner_radius_bottom_left.description: The bottom-left corner's radius. If 0, the corner is not rounded.

corner_detail.description:
This sets the number of vertices used for each corner. Higher values result in rounder corners but take more processing power to compute. When choosing a value, you should take the corner radius (set_corner_radius_all) into account.
			For corner radii less than 10, 4 or 5 should be enough. For corner radii less than 30, values between 8 and 12 should be enough.
			A corner detail of 1 will result in chamfered corners instead of rounded corners, which is useful for some artistic effects.

expand_margin_left.description:
Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the left edge. Useful in combination with border_width_left to draw a border outside the control rect.
			Note: Unlike StyleBox.content_margin_left, expand_margin_left does not affect the size of the clickable area for s. This can negatively impact usability if used wrong, as the user may try to click an area of the StyleBox that cannot actually receive clicks.

expand_margin_top.description:
Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the top edge. Useful in combination with border_width_top to draw a border outside the control rect.
			Note: Unlike StyleBox.content_margin_top, expand_margin_top does not affect the size of the clickable area for s. This can negatively impact usability if used wrong, as the user may try to click an area of the StyleBox that cannot actually receive clicks.

expand_margin_right.description:
Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the right edge. Useful in combination with border_width_right to draw a border outside the control rect.
			Note: Unlike StyleBox.content_margin_right, expand_margin_right does not affect the size of the clickable area for s. This can negatively impact usability if used wrong, as the user may try to click an area of the StyleBox that cannot actually receive clicks.

expand_margin_bottom.description:
Expands the stylebox outside of the control rect on the bottom edge. Useful in combination with border_width_bottom to draw a border outside the control rect.
			Note: Unlike StyleBox.content_margin_bottom, expand_margin_bottom does not affect the size of the clickable area for s. This can negatively impact usability if used wrong, as the user may try to click an area of the StyleBox that cannot actually receive clicks.

shadow_color.description: The color of the shadow. This has no effect if shadow_size is lower than 1.

shadow_offset.description: The shadow offset in pixels. Adjusts the position of the shadow relatively to the stylebox.

anti_aliasing.description:
Antialiasing draws a small ring around the edges, which fades to transparency. As a result, edges look much smoother. This is only noticeable when using rounded corners or skew.
			Note: When using beveled corners with 45-degree angles (corner_detail = 1), it is recommended to set anti_aliasing to false to ensure crisp visuals and avoid possible visual glitches.

anti_aliasing_size.description:
This changes the size of the antialiasing effect. 1.0 is recommended for an optimal result at 100% scale, identical to how rounded rectangles are rendered in web browsers and most vector drawing software.
			Note: Higher values may produce a blur effect but can also create undesired artifacts on small boxes with large-radius corners.

StyleBoxLine.brief_description: A  that displays a single line of a given color and thickness.
StyleBoxLine.description: A  that displays a single line of a given color and thickness. The line can be either horizontal or vertical. Useful for separators.

grow_begin.description: The number of pixels the line will extend before the 's bounds. If set to a negative value, the line will begin inside the 's bounds.

grow_end.description: The number of pixels the line will extend past the 's bounds. If set to a negative value, the line will end inside the 's bounds.

vertical.description: If true, the line will be vertical. If false, the line will be horizontal.

StyleBoxTexture.description: A texture-based nine-patch , in a way similar to . This stylebox performs a 3×3 scaling of a texture, where only the center cell is fully stretched. This makes it possible to design bordered styles regardless of the stylebox's size.

set_texture_margin.description: Sets the margin to size pixels for the specified .

set_texture_margin_all.description: Sets the margin to size pixels for all sides.

get_texture_margin.description: Returns the margin size of the specified .

set_expand_margin.description: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for the specified .

set_expand_margin_all.description: Sets the expand margin to size pixels for all sides.

get_expand_margin.description: Returns the expand margin size of the specified .

texture.description: The texture to use when drawing this style box.

texture_margin_left.description:
Increases the left margin of the 3×3 texture box.
			A higher value means more of the source texture is considered to be part of the left border of the 3×3 box.
			This is also the value used as fallback for StyleBox.content_margin_left if it is negative.

texture_margin_top.description:
Increases the top margin of the 3×3 texture box.
			A higher value means more of the source texture is considered to be part of the top border of the 3×3 box.
			This is also the value used as fallback for StyleBox.content_margin_top if it is negative.

texture_margin_right.description:
Increases the right margin of the 3×3 texture box.
			A higher value means more of the source texture is considered to be part of the right border of the 3×3 box.
			This is also the value used as fallback for StyleBox.content_margin_right if it is negative.

texture_margin_bottom.description:
Increases the bottom margin of the 3×3 texture box.
			A higher value means more of the source texture is considered to be part of the bottom border of the 3×3 box.
			This is also the value used as fallback for StyleBox.content_margin_bottom if it is negative.

expand_margin_left.description: Expands the left margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.

expand_margin_top.description: Expands the top margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.

expand_margin_right.description: Expands the right margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.

expand_margin_bottom.description: Expands the bottom margin of this style box when drawing, causing it to be drawn larger than requested.

axis_stretch_horizontal.description: Controls how the stylebox's texture will be stretched or tiled horizontally.

axis_stretch_vertical.description: Controls how the stylebox's texture will be stretched or tiled vertically.

region_rect.description:
The region to use from the texture.
			This is equivalent to first wrapping the texture in an  with the same region.
			If empty (Rect2(0, 0, 0, 0)), the whole texture is used.

modulate_color.description: Modulates the color of the texture when this style box is drawn.

draw_center.description: If true, the nine-patch texture's center tile will be drawn.

SubViewport.brief_description: An interface to a game world that doesn't create a window or draw to the screen directly.
SubViewport.description:
Isolates a rectangular region of a scene to be displayed independently. This can be used, for example, to display UI in 3D space.
		Note:  is a  that isn't a , i.e. it doesn't draw anything by itself. To display anything,  must have a non-zero size and be either put inside a  or assigned to a .
		Note: s are not passed to a standalone  by default. To ensure  propagation, a  can be placed inside of a .

size.description:
The width and height of the sub-viewport. Must be set to a value greater than or equal to 2 pixels on both dimensions. Otherwise, nothing will be displayed.
			Note: If the parent node is a  and its SubViewportContainer.stretch is true, the viewport size cannot be changed manually.

size_2d_override.description: The 2D size override of the sub-viewport. If either the width or height is 0, the override is disabled.

size_2d_override_stretch.description: If true, the 2D size override affects stretch as well.

render_target_clear_mode.description:
The clear mode when the sub-viewport is used as a render target.
			Note: This property is intended for 2D usage.

render_target_update_mode.description: The update mode when the sub-viewport is used as a render target.

SubViewportContainer.brief_description: A container used for displaying the contents of a .
SubViewportContainer.description:
A container that displays the contents of underlying  child nodes. It uses the combined size of the s as minimum size, unless stretch is enabled.
		Note: Changing a 's Control.scale will cause its contents to appear distorted. To change its visual size without causing distortion, adjust the node's margins instead (if it's not already in a container).
		Note: The  forwards mouse-enter and mouse-exit notifications to its sub-viewports.

_propagate_input_event.description: Virtual method to be implemented by the user. If it returns true, the event is propagated to  children. Propagation doesn't happen if it returns false. If the function is not implemented, all events are propagated to SubViewports.

stretch.description:
If true, the sub-viewport will be automatically resized to the control's size.
			Note: If true, this will prohibit changing SubViewport.size of its children manually.

stretch_shrink.description:
Divides the sub-viewport's effective resolution by this value while preserving its scale. This can be used to speed up rendering.
			For example, a 1280×720 sub-viewport with stretch_shrink set to 2 will be rendered at 640×360 while occupying the same size in the container.
			Note: stretch must be true for this property to work.

mouse_target.description:
Configure, if either the  or alternatively the  nodes of its  children should be available as targets of mouse-related functionalities, like identifying the drop target in drag-and-drop operations or cursor shape of hovered  node.
			If false, the  nodes inside its  children are considered as targets.
			If true, the  itself will be considered as a target.

SubtweenTweener.description:
is used to execute a  as one step in a sequence defined by another . See Tween.tween_subtween for more usage information.
		Note: Tween.tween_subtween is the only correct way to create . Any  created manually will not function correctly.

set_delay.description: Sets the time in seconds after which the  will start running the subtween. By default there's no delay.

set_skin_weight_count.description:
Set to  to indicate that up to 8 bone influences per vertex may be used.
				By default, only 4 bone influences are used ().
				Note: This function takes an enum, not the exact number of weights.

get_skin_weight_count.description:
By default, returns  to indicate only 4 bone influences per vertex are used.
				Returns  if up to 8 influences are used.
				Note: This function returns an enum, not the exact number of weights.

set_custom_format.description:
Sets the color format for this custom channel_index. Use  to disable.
				Must be invoked after begin and should be set before commit or commit_to_arrays.

get_custom_format.description: Returns the format for custom channel_index (currently up to 4). Returns  if this custom channel is unused.

begin.description: Called before adding any vertices. Takes the primitive type as an argument (e.g. ).

add_vertex.description: Specifies the position of current vertex. Should be called after specifying other vertex properties (e.g. Color, UV).

set_color.description:
Specifies a  to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
				Note: The material must have BaseMaterial3D.vertex_color_use_as_albedo enabled for the vertex color to be visible.

set_normal.description: Specifies a normal to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

set_tangent.description:
Specifies a tangent to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.
				Note: Even though tangent is a , it does not directly represent the tangent plane. Its Plane.x, Plane.y, and Plane.z represent the tangent vector and Plane.d should be either -1 or 1. See also .

set_uv.description: Specifies a set of UV coordinates to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

set_uv2.description: Specifies an optional second set of UV coordinates to use for the next vertex. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

set_bones.description: Specifies an array of bones to use for the next vertex. bones must contain 4 integers.

set_weights.description: Specifies weight values to use for the next vertex. weights must contain 4 values. If every vertex needs to have this information set and you fail to submit it for the first vertex, this information may not be used at all.

set_custom.description:
Sets the custom value on this vertex for channel_index.
				set_custom_format must be called first for this channel_index. Formats which are not RGBA will ignore other color channels.

set_smooth_group.description:
Specifies the smooth group to use for the next vertex. If this is never called, all vertices will have the default smooth group of 0 and will be smoothed with adjacent vertices of the same group. To produce a mesh with flat normals, set the smooth group to -1.
				Note: This function actually takes a uint32_t, so C# users should use uint32.MaxValue instead of -1 to produce a mesh with flat normals.

add_triangle_fan.description:
Inserts a triangle fan made of array data into  being constructed.
				Requires the primitive type be set to .

add_index.description: Adds a vertex to index array if you are using indexed vertices. Does not need to be called before adding vertices.

index.description: Shrinks the vertex array by creating an index array. This can improve performance by avoiding vertex reuse.

deindex.description: Removes the index array by expanding the vertex array.

generate_normals.description:
Generates normals from vertices so you do not have to do it manually. If flip is true, the resulting normals will be inverted. generate_normals should be called after generating geometry and before committing the mesh using commit or commit_to_arrays. For correct display of normal-mapped surfaces, you will also have to generate tangents using generate_tangents.
				Note: generate_normals only works if the primitive type is set to .
				Note: generate_normals takes smooth groups into account. To generate smooth normals, set the smooth group to a value greater than or equal to 0 using set_smooth_group or leave the smooth group at the default of 0. To generate flat normals, set the smooth group to -1 using set_smooth_group prior to adding vertices.

generate_tangents.description: Generates a tangent vector for each vertex. Requires that each vertex already has UVs and normals set (see generate_normals).

optimize_indices_for_cache.description: Optimizes triangle sorting for performance. Requires that get_primitive_type is .

get_aabb.description: Returns the axis-aligned bounding box of the vertex positions.

generate_lod.description: Generates an LOD for a given nd_threshold in linear units (square root of quadric error metric), using at most target_index_count indices.

set_material.description: Sets  to be used by the  you are constructing.

get_primitive_type.description: Returns the type of mesh geometry, such as .

clear.description: Clear all information passed into the surface tool so far.

create_from.description: Creates a vertex array from an existing .

create_from_arrays.description: Creates this SurfaceTool from existing vertex arrays such as returned by commit_to_arrays, Mesh.surface_get_arrays, Mesh.surface_get_blend_shape_arrays, ImporterMesh.get_surface_arrays, and ImporterMesh.get_surface_blend_shape_arrays. primitive_type controls the type of mesh data, defaulting to .

create_from_blend_shape.description: Creates a vertex array from the specified blend shape of an existing . This can be used to extract a specific pose from a blend shape.

append_from.description: Append vertices from a given  surface onto the current vertex array with specified .

commit.description:
Returns a constructed  from current information passed in. If an existing  is passed in as an argument, will add an extra surface to the existing .
				The flags argument can be the bitwise OR of , , or .

commit_to_arrays.description: Commits the data to the same format used by ArrayMesh.add_surface_from_arrays, ImporterMesh.add_surface, and create_from_arrays. This way you can further process the mesh data using the  or  APIs.

SyntaxHighlighter.brief_description: Base class for syntax highlighters. Provides syntax highlighting data to a .
SyntaxHighlighter.description:
Base class for syntax highlighters. Provides syntax highlighting data to a . The associated  will call into the  on an as-needed basis.
		Note: A  instance should not be used across multiple  nodes.

_get_line_syntax_highlighting.description:
Virtual method which can be overridden to return syntax highlighting data.
				See get_line_syntax_highlighting for more details.

_clear_highlighting_cache.description: Virtual method which can be overridden to clear any local caches.

_update_cache.description: Virtual method which can be overridden to update any local caches.

update_cache.description:
Clears then updates the  caches. Override _update_cache for a callback.
				Note: This is called automatically when the associated  node, updates its own cache.

clear_highlighting_cache.description:
Clears all cached syntax highlighting data.
				Then calls overridable method _clear_highlighting_cache.

SystemFont.brief_description: A font loaded from a system font. Falls back to a default theme font if not implemented on the host OS.
SystemFont.description:
loads a font from a system font with the first matching name from font_names.
		It will attempt to match font style, but it's not guaranteed.
		The returned font might be part of a font collection or be a variable font with OpenType "weight", "width" and/or "italic" features set.
		You can create  of the system font for precise control over its features.
		Note: This class is implemented on iOS, Linux, macOS and Windows, on other platforms it will fallback to default theme font.

font_names.description: Array of font family names to search, first matching font found is used.

font_italic.description: If set to true, italic or oblique font is preferred.

font_weight.description: Preferred weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.

font_stretch.description: Preferred font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.

generate_mipmaps.description: If set to true, generate mipmaps for the font textures.

disable_embedded_bitmaps.description: If set to true, embedded font bitmap loading is disabled (bitmap-only and color fonts ignore this property).

allow_system_fallback.description: If set to true, system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

force_autohinter.description: If set to true, auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting.

modulate_color_glyphs.description: If set to true, color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.

subpixel_positioning.description: Font glyph subpixel positioning mode. Subpixel positioning provides shaper text and better kerning for smaller font sizes, at the cost of memory usage and font rasterization speed. Use  to automatically enable it based on the font size.

keep_rounding_remainders.description: If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

multichannel_signed_distance_field.description: If set to true, glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.

msdf_pixel_range.description: The width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance. If using font outlines, msdf_pixel_range must be set to at least twice the size of the largest font outline. The default msdf_pixel_range value of 16 allows outline sizes up to 8 to look correct.

msdf_size.description: Source font size used to generate MSDF textures. Higher values allow for more precision, but are slower to render and require more memory. Only increase this value if you notice a visible lack of precision in glyph rendering.

oversampling.description: If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods.

TCPServer.description:
A TCP server. Listens to connections on a port and returns a  when it gets an incoming connection.
		Note: When exporting to Android, make sure to enable the INTERNET permission in the Android export preset before exporting the project or using one-click deploy. Otherwise, network communication of any kind will be blocked by Android.

listen.description:
Listen on the port binding to bind_address.
				If bind_address is set as "*" (default), the server will listen on all available addresses (both IPv4 and IPv6).
				If bind_address is set as "0.0.0.0" (for IPv4) or "::" (for IPv6), the server will listen on all available addresses matching that IP type.
				If bind_address is set to any valid address (e.g. "192.168.1.101", "::1", etc.), the server will only listen on the interface with that address (or fail if no interface with the given address exists).

get_local_port.description: Returns the local port this server is listening to.

take_connection.description: If a connection is available, returns a StreamPeerTCP with the connection.

TLSOptions.brief_description: TLS configuration for clients and servers.

client.description:
Creates a TLS client configuration which validates certificates and their common names (fully qualified domain names).
				You can specify a custom trusted_chain of certification authorities (the default CA list will be used if null), and optionally provide a common_name_override if you expect the certificate to have a common name other than the server FQDN.
				Note: On the Web platform, TLS verification is always enforced against the CA list of the web browser. This is considered a security feature.

client_unsafe.description:
Creates an unsafe TLS client configuration where certificate validation is optional. You can optionally provide a valid trusted_chain, but the common name of the certificates will never be checked. Using this configuration for purposes other than testing is not recommended.
				Note: On the Web platform, TLS verification is always enforced against the CA list of the web browser. This is considered a security feature.

server.description:
Creates a TLS server configuration using the provided key and certificate.
				Note: The certificate should include the full certificate chain up to the signing CA (certificates file can be concatenated using a general purpose text editor).

is_server.description: Returns true if created with TLSOptions.server, false otherwise.

is_unsafe_client.description: Returns true if created with TLSOptions.client_unsafe, false otherwise.

get_common_name_override.description: Returns the common name (domain name) override specified when creating with TLSOptions.client.

get_trusted_ca_chain.description: Returns the CA  chain specified when creating with TLSOptions.client or TLSOptions.client_unsafe.

get_private_key.description: Returns the  specified when creating with TLSOptions.server.

get_own_certificate.description: Returns the  specified when creating with TLSOptions.server.

TabBar.brief_description: A control that provides a horizontal bar with tabs.
TabBar.description: A control that provides a horizontal bar with tabs. Similar to  but is only in charge of drawing tabs, not interacting with children.

get_previous_tab.description: Returns the previously active tab index.

select_previous_available.description: Selects the first available tab with lower index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.

select_next_available.description: Selects the first available tab with greater index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.

set_tab_title.description: Sets a title for the tab at index tab_idx.

get_tab_title.description: Returns the title of the tab at index tab_idx.

set_tab_tooltip.description:
Sets a tooltip for tab at index tab_idx.
				Note: By default, if the tooltip is empty and the tab text is truncated (not all characters fit into the tab), the title will be displayed as a tooltip. To hide the tooltip, assign " " as the tooltip text.

get_tab_tooltip.description: Returns the tooltip text of the tab at index tab_idx.

set_tab_text_direction.description: Sets tab title base writing direction.

get_tab_text_direction.description: Returns tab title text base writing direction.

set_tab_language.description: Sets the language code of the title for the tab at index tab_idx to language. This is used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If language is empty, the current locale is used.

set_tab_icon.description: Sets an icon for the tab at index tab_idx.

get_tab_icon.description: Returns the icon for the tab at index tab_idx or null if the tab has no icon.

set_tab_icon_max_width.description: Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and on top of . The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.

get_tab_icon_max_width.description: Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx.

set_tab_button_icon.description: Sets an icon for the button of the tab at index tab_idx (located to the right, before the close button), making it visible and clickable (See ). Giving it a null value will hide the button.

get_tab_button_icon.description: Returns the icon for the right button of the tab at index tab_idx or null if the right button has no icon.

set_tab_disabled.description: If disabled is true, disables the tab at index tab_idx, making it non-interactable.

is_tab_disabled.description: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is disabled.

set_tab_hidden.description: If hidden is true, hides the tab at index tab_idx, making it disappear from the tab area.

is_tab_hidden.description: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is hidden.

set_tab_metadata.description: Sets the metadata value for the tab at index tab_idx, which can be retrieved later using get_tab_metadata.

get_tab_metadata.description: Returns the metadata value set to the tab at index tab_idx using set_tab_metadata. If no metadata was previously set, returns null by default.

remove_tab.description: Removes the tab at index tab_idx.

get_tab_idx_at_point.description: Returns the index of the tab at local coordinates point. Returns -1 if the point is outside the control boundaries or if there's no tab at the queried position.

get_tab_offset.description: Returns the number of hidden tabs offsetted to the left.

get_offset_buttons_visible.description: Returns true if the offset buttons (the ones that appear when there's not enough space for all tabs) are visible.

ensure_tab_visible.description: Moves the scroll view to make the tab visible.

get_tab_rect.description: Returns tab  with local position and size.

move_tab.description: Moves a tab from from to to.

current_tab.description: The index of the current selected tab. A value of -1 means that no tab is selected and can only be set when deselect_enabled is true or if all tabs are hidden or disabled.

tab_alignment.description: The horizontal alignment of the tabs.

clip_tabs.description: If true, tabs overflowing this node's width will be hidden, displaying two navigation buttons instead. Otherwise, this node's minimum size is updated so that all tabs are visible.

close_with_middle_mouse.description: If true, middle-clicking on a tab will emit the  signal.

tab_close_display_policy.description: When the close button will appear on the tabs.

max_tab_width.description: Sets the maximum width which all tabs should be limited to. Unlimited if set to 0.

scrolling_enabled.description: if true, the mouse's scroll wheel can be used to navigate the scroll view.

drag_to_rearrange_enabled.description: If true, tabs can be rearranged with mouse drag.

switch_on_drag_hover.description: If true, hovering over a tab while dragging something will switch to that tab. Does not have effect when hovering another tab to rearrange. The delay for when this happens is dictated by .

tabs_rearrange_group.description:
s with the same rearrange group ID will allow dragging the tabs between them. Enable drag with drag_to_rearrange_enabled.
			Setting this to -1 will disable rearranging between s.

scroll_to_selected.description: If true, the tab offset will be changed to keep the currently selected tab visible.

select_with_rmb.description: If true, enables selecting a tab with the right mouse button.

deselect_enabled.description: If true, all tabs can be deselected so that no tab is selected. Click on the current tab to deselect it.

tab_count.description: The number of tabs currently in the bar.

TabContainer.brief_description: A container that creates a tab for each child control, displaying only the active tab's control.
TabContainer.description:
Arranges child controls into a tabbed view, creating a tab for each one. The active tab's corresponding control is made visible, while all other child controls are hidden. Ignores non-control children.
		Note: The drawing of the clickable tabs is handled by this node;  is not needed.

get_previous_tab.description: Returns the previously active tab index.

select_previous_available.description: Selects the first available tab with lower index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.

select_next_available.description: Selects the first available tab with greater index than the currently selected. Returns true if tab selection changed.

get_current_tab_control.description: Returns the child  node located at the active tab index.

get_tab_bar.description:
Returns the  contained in this container.
				Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it or editing its tabs may cause a crash. If you wish to edit the tabs, use the methods provided in .

get_tab_control.description: Returns the  node from the tab at index tab_idx.

set_tab_title.description: Sets a custom title for the tab at index tab_idx (tab titles default to the name of the indexed child node). Set it back to the child's name to make the tab default to it again.

get_tab_title.description: Returns the title of the tab at index tab_idx. Tab titles default to the name of the indexed child node, but this can be overridden with set_tab_title.

set_tab_tooltip.description:
Sets a custom tooltip text for tab at index tab_idx.
				Note: By default, if the tooltip is empty and the tab text is truncated (not all characters fit into the tab), the title will be displayed as a tooltip. To hide the tooltip, assign " " as the tooltip text.

get_tab_tooltip.description: Returns the tooltip text of the tab at index tab_idx.

set_tab_icon.description: Sets an icon for the tab at index tab_idx.

get_tab_icon.description: Returns the  for the tab at index tab_idx or null if the tab has no .

set_tab_icon_max_width.description: Sets the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx. This limit is applied on top of the default size of the icon and on top of . The height is adjusted according to the icon's ratio.

get_tab_icon_max_width.description: Returns the maximum allowed width of the icon for the tab at index tab_idx.

set_tab_disabled.description: If disabled is true, disables the tab at index tab_idx, making it non-interactable.

is_tab_disabled.description: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is disabled.

set_tab_hidden.description: If hidden is true, hides the tab at index tab_idx, making it disappear from the tab area.

is_tab_hidden.description: Returns true if the tab at index tab_idx is hidden.

set_tab_metadata.description: Sets the metadata value for the tab at index tab_idx, which can be retrieved later using get_tab_metadata.

get_tab_metadata.description: Returns the metadata value set to the tab at index tab_idx using set_tab_metadata. If no metadata was previously set, returns null by default.

set_tab_button_icon.description: Sets the button icon from the tab at index tab_idx.

get_tab_button_icon.description: Returns the button icon from the tab at index tab_idx.

get_tab_idx_at_point.description: Returns the index of the tab at local coordinates point. Returns -1 if the point is outside the control boundaries or if there's no tab at the queried position.

get_tab_idx_from_control.description: Returns the index of the tab tied to the given control. The control must be a child of the .

set_popup.description: If set on a  node instance, a popup menu icon appears in the top-right corner of the  (setting it to null will make it go away). Clicking it will expand the  node.

get_popup.description:
Returns the  node instance if one has been set already with set_popup.
				Warning: This is a required internal node, removing and freeing it may cause a crash. If you wish to hide it or any of its children, use their Window.visible property.

tab_alignment.description: The position at which tabs will be placed.

current_tab.description:
The current tab index. When set, this index's  node's visible property is set to true and all others are set to false.
			A value of -1 means that no tab is selected.

tabs_position.description: The horizontal alignment of the tabs.

clip_tabs.description: If true, tabs overflowing this node's width will be hidden, displaying two navigation buttons instead. Otherwise, this node's minimum size is updated so that all tabs are visible.

tabs_visible.description: If true, tabs are visible. If false, tabs' content and titles are hidden.

all_tabs_in_front.description: If true, all tabs are drawn in front of the panel. If false, inactive tabs are drawn behind the panel.

switch_on_drag_hover.description: If true, hovering over a tab while dragging something will switch to that tab. Does not have effect when hovering another tab to rearrange.

drag_to_rearrange_enabled.description: If true, tabs can be rearranged with mouse drag.

tabs_rearrange_group.description:
s with the same rearrange group ID will allow dragging the tabs between them. Enable drag with drag_to_rearrange_enabled.
			Setting this to -1 will disable rearranging between s.

use_hidden_tabs_for_min_size.description: If true, child  nodes that are hidden have their minimum size take into account in the total, instead of only the currently visible one.

tab_focus_mode.description: The focus access mode for the internal  node.

deselect_enabled.description:
If true, all tabs can be deselected so that no tab is selected. Click on the current_tab to deselect it.
			Only the tab header will be shown if no tabs are selected.

TextEdit.description:
A multiline text editor. It also has limited facilities for editing code, such as syntax highlighting support. For more advanced facilities for editing code, see .
		While entering text, it is possible to insert special characters using Unicode, OEM or Windows alt codes:
		- To enter Unicode codepoints, hold Alt and type the codepoint on the numpad. For example, to enter the character á (U+00E1), hold Alt and type +E1 on the numpad (the leading zeroes can be omitted).
		- To enter OEM codepoints, hold Alt and type the code on the numpad. For example, to enter the character á (OEM 160), hold Alt and type 160 on the numpad.
		- To enter Windows codepoints, hold Alt and type the code on the numpad. For example, to enter the character á (Windows 0225), hold Alt and type 0, 2, 2, 5 on the numpad. The leading zero here must not be omitted, as this is how Windows codepoints are distinguished from OEM codepoints.
		Note: Most viewport, caret, and edit methods contain a caret_index argument for caret_multiple support. The argument should be one of the following: -1 for all carets, 0 for the main caret, or greater than 0 for secondary carets in the order they were created.
		Note: When holding down Alt, the vertical scroll wheel will scroll 5 times as fast as it would normally do. This also works in the Godot script editor.

_handle_unicode_input.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user types in the provided key unicode_char.

_backspace.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user presses the backspace key.

_cut.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a cut operation.

_copy.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a copy operation.

_paste.description: Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation.

_paste_primary_clipboard.description:
Override this method to define what happens when the user performs a paste operation with middle mouse button.
				Note: This method is only implemented on Linux.

has_ime_text.description: Returns true if the user has text in the Input Method Editor (IME).

cancel_ime.description: Closes the Input Method Editor (IME) if it is open. Any text in the IME will be lost.

apply_ime.description: Applies text from the Input Method Editor (IME) to each caret and closes the IME if it is open.

set_tab_size.description: Sets the tab size for the  to use.

set_overtype_mode_enabled.description: If true, enables overtype mode. In this mode, typing overrides existing text instead of inserting text. The ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_toggle_insert_mode action toggles overtype mode. See is_overtype_mode_enabled.

is_overtype_mode_enabled.description: Returns true if overtype mode is enabled. See set_overtype_mode_enabled.

clear.description: Performs a full reset of , including undo history.

get_line_count.description: Returns the number of lines in the text.

set_line.description:
Sets the text for a specific line.
				Carets on the line will attempt to keep their visual x position.

get_line.description: Returns the text of a specific line.

get_line_with_ime.description: Returns line text as it is currently displayed, including IME composition string.

get_line_width.description: Returns the width in pixels of the wrap_index on line.

get_line_height.description:
Returns the maximum value of the line height among all lines.
				Note: The return value is influenced by  and . And it will not be less than 1.

get_indent_level.description: Returns the indent level of the given line. This is the number of spaces and tabs at the beginning of the line, with the tabs taking the tab size into account (see get_tab_size).

get_first_non_whitespace_column.description: Returns the first column containing a non-whitespace character on the given line. If there is only whitespace, returns the number of characters.

swap_lines.description: Swaps the two lines. Carets will be swapped with the lines.

insert_line_at.description: Inserts a new line with text at line.

remove_line_at.description:
Removes the line of text at line. Carets on this line will attempt to match their previous visual x position.
				If move_carets_down is true carets will move to the next line down, otherwise carets will move up.

insert_text_at_caret.description: Insert the specified text at the caret position.

insert_text.description:
Inserts the text at line and column.
				If before_selection_begin is true, carets and selections that begin at line and column will moved to the end of the inserted text, along with all carets after it.
				If before_selection_end is true, selections that end at line and column will be extended to the end of the inserted text. These parameters can be used to insert text inside of or outside of selections.

remove_text.description: Removes text between the given positions.

get_last_unhidden_line.description: Returns the last unhidden line in the entire .

get_next_visible_line_offset_from.description: Returns the count to the next visible line from line to line + visible_amount. Can also count backwards. For example if a  has 5 lines with lines 2 and 3 hidden, calling this with line = 1, visible_amount = 1 would return 3.

get_next_visible_line_index_offset_from.description: Similar to get_next_visible_line_offset_from, but takes into account the line wrap indexes. In the returned vector, x is the line, y is the wrap index.

backspace.description: Called when the user presses the backspace key. Can be overridden with _backspace.

cut.description: Cut's the current selection. Can be overridden with _cut.

copy.description: Copies the current text selection. Can be overridden with _copy.

paste.description: Paste at the current location. Can be overridden with _paste.

start_action.description:
Starts an action, will end the current action if action is different.
				An action will also end after a call to end_action, after ProjectSettings.gui/timers/text_edit_idle_detect_sec is triggered or a new undoable step outside the start_action and end_action calls.

end_action.description: Marks the end of steps in the current action started with start_action.

begin_complex_operation.description: Starts a multipart edit. All edits will be treated as one action until end_complex_operation is called.

end_complex_operation.description: Ends a multipart edit, started with begin_complex_operation. If called outside a complex operation, the current operation is pushed onto the undo/redo stack.

has_undo.description: Returns true if an "undo" action is available.

has_redo.description: Returns true if a "redo" action is available.

tag_saved_version.description: Tag the current version as saved.

get_version.description: Returns the current version of the . The version is a count of recorded operations by the undo/redo history.

get_saved_version.description: Returns the last tagged saved version from tag_saved_version.

set_search_text.description: Sets the search text. See set_search_flags.

set_search_flags.description: Sets the search flags. This is used with set_search_text to highlight occurrences of the searched text. Search flags can be specified from the  enum.

set_tooltip_request_func.description: Provide custom tooltip text. The callback method must take the following args: hovered_word: String.

get_local_mouse_pos.description: Returns the local mouse position adjusted for the text direction.

get_line_column_at_pos.description:
Returns the line and column at the given position. In the returned vector, x is the column and y is the line.
				If clamp_line is false and position is below the last line, Vector2i(-1, -1) is returned.
				If clamp_column is false and position is outside the column range of the line, Vector2i(-1, -1) is returned.

get_pos_at_line_column.description:
Returns the local position for the given line and column. If x or y of the returned vector equal -1, the position is outside of the viewable area of the control.
				Note: The Y position corresponds to the bottom side of the line. Use get_rect_at_line_column to get the top side position.

get_rect_at_line_column.description:
Returns the local position and size for the grapheme at the given line and column. If x or y position of the returned rect equal -1, the position is outside of the viewable area of the control.
				Note: The Y position of the returned rect corresponds to the top side of the line, unlike get_pos_at_line_column which returns the bottom side.

get_minimap_line_at_pos.description: Returns the equivalent minimap line at position.

is_dragging_cursor.description: Returns true if the user is dragging their mouse for scrolling, selecting, or text dragging.

is_mouse_over_selection.description: Returns true if the mouse is over a selection. If edges is true, the edges are considered part of the selection.

add_caret.description: Adds a new caret at the given location. Returns the index of the new caret, or -1 if the location is invalid.

remove_caret.description:
Removes the given caret index.
				Note: This can result in adjustment of all other caret indices.

get_caret_count.description: Returns the number of carets in this .

add_caret_at_carets.description: Adds an additional caret above or below every caret. If below is true the new caret will be added below and above otherwise.

get_sorted_carets.description:
Returns the carets sorted by selection beginning from lowest line and column to highest (from top to bottom of text).
				If include_ignored_carets is false, carets from multicaret_edit_ignore_caret will be ignored.

collapse_carets.description:
Collapse all carets in the given range to the from_line and from_column position.
				inclusive applies to both ends.
				If is_in_mulitcaret_edit is true, carets that are collapsed will be true for multicaret_edit_ignore_caret.
				merge_overlapping_carets will be called if any carets were collapsed.

merge_overlapping_carets.description:
Merges any overlapping carets. Will favor the newest caret, or the caret with a selection.
				If is_in_mulitcaret_edit is true, the merge will be queued to happen at the end of the multicaret edit. See begin_multicaret_edit and end_multicaret_edit.
				Note: This is not called when a caret changes position but after certain actions, so it is possible to get into a state where carets overlap.

begin_multicaret_edit.description:
Starts an edit for multiple carets. The edit must be ended with end_multicaret_edit. Multicaret edits can be used to edit text at multiple carets and delay merging the carets until the end, so the caret indexes aren't affected immediately. begin_multicaret_edit and end_multicaret_edit can be nested, and the merge will happen at the last end_multicaret_edit.
				
				begin_complex_operation()
				begin_multicaret_edit()
				for i in range(get_caret_count()):
					if multicaret_edit_ignore_caret(i):
						continue
					# Logic here.
				end_multicaret_edit()
				end_complex_operation()

end_multicaret_edit.description: Ends an edit for multiple carets, that was started with begin_multicaret_edit. If this was the last end_multicaret_edit and merge_overlapping_carets was called, carets will be merged.

is_in_mulitcaret_edit.description: Returns true if a begin_multicaret_edit has been called and end_multicaret_edit has not yet been called.

multicaret_edit_ignore_caret.description:
Returns true if the given caret_index should be ignored as part of a multicaret edit. See begin_multicaret_edit and end_multicaret_edit. Carets that should be ignored are ones that were part of removed text and will likely be merged at the end of the edit, or carets that were added during the edit.
				It is recommended to continue within a loop iterating on multiple carets if a caret should be ignored.

is_caret_visible.description:
Returns true if the caret is visible, false otherwise. A caret will be considered hidden if it is outside the scrollable area when scrolling is enabled.
				Note: is_caret_visible does not account for a caret being off-screen if it is still within the scrollable area. It will return true even if the caret is off-screen as long as it meets 's own conditions for being visible. This includes uses of scroll_fit_content_width and scroll_fit_content_height that cause the  to expand beyond the viewport's bounds.

get_caret_draw_pos.description: Returns the caret pixel draw position.

set_caret_line.description:
Moves the caret to the specified line index. The caret column will be moved to the same visual position it was at the last time set_caret_column was called, or clamped to the end of the line.
				If adjust_viewport is true, the viewport will center at the caret position after the move occurs.
				If can_be_hidden is true, the specified line can be hidden.
				If wrap_index is -1, the caret column will be clamped to the line's length. If wrap_index is greater than -1, the column will be moved to attempt to match the visual x position on the line's wrap_index to the position from the last time set_caret_column was called.
				Note: If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See merge_overlapping_carets.

get_caret_line.description: Returns the line the editing caret is on.

set_caret_column.description:
Moves the caret to the specified column index.
				If adjust_viewport is true, the viewport will center at the caret position after the move occurs.
				Note: If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See merge_overlapping_carets.

get_caret_column.description: Returns the column the editing caret is at.

get_next_composite_character_column.description:
Returns the correct column at the end of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the start of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters.
				Note: To check at caret location use get_next_composite_character_column(get_caret_line(), get_caret_column())

get_previous_composite_character_column.description:
Returns the correct column at the start of a composite character like ❤️‍🩹 (mending heart; Unicode: U+2764 U+FE0F U+200D U+1FA79) which is comprised of more than one Unicode code point, if the caret is at the end of the composite character. Also returns the correct column with the caret at mid grapheme and for non-composite characters.
				Note: To check at caret location use get_previous_composite_character_column(get_caret_line(), get_caret_column())

get_caret_wrap_index.description: Returns the wrap index the editing caret is on.

get_word_under_caret.description: Returns a  text with the word under the caret's location.

select_all.description:
Select all the text.
				If selecting_enabled is false, no selection will occur.

select_word_under_caret.description: Selects the word under the caret.

add_selection_for_next_occurrence.description: Adds a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, selects word under caret.

skip_selection_for_next_occurrence.description: Moves a selection and a caret for the next occurrence of the current selection. If there is no active selection, moves to the next occurrence of the word under caret.

select.description:
Selects text from origin_line and origin_column to caret_line and caret_column for the given caret_index. This moves the selection origin and the caret. If the positions are the same, the selection will be deselected.
				If selecting_enabled is false, no selection will occur.
				Note: If supporting multiple carets this will not check for any overlap. See merge_overlapping_carets.

has_selection.description: Returns true if the user has selected text.

get_selected_text.description: Returns the text inside the selection of a caret, or all the carets if caret_index is its default value -1.

get_selection_at_line_column.description:
Returns the caret index of the selection at the given line and column, or -1 if there is none.
				If include_edges is false, the position must be inside the selection and not at either end. If only_selections is false, carets without a selection will also be considered.

get_line_ranges_from_carets.description:
Returns an  of line ranges where x is the first line and y is the last line. All lines within these ranges will have a caret on them or be part of a selection. Each line will only be part of one line range, even if it has multiple carets on it.
				If a selection's end column (get_selection_to_column) is at column 0, that line will not be included. If a selection begins on the line after another selection ends and merge_adjacent is true, or they begin and end on the same line, one line range will include both selections.

get_selection_origin_line.description: Returns the origin line of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.

get_selection_origin_column.description: Returns the origin column of the selection. This is the opposite end from the caret.

set_selection_origin_line.description:
Sets the selection origin line to the line for the given caret_index. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect.
				If can_be_hidden is false, The line will be set to the nearest unhidden line below or above.
				If wrap_index is -1, the selection origin column will be clamped to the line's length. If wrap_index is greater than -1, the column will be moved to attempt to match the visual x position on the line's wrap_index to the position from the last time set_selection_origin_column or select was called.

set_selection_origin_column.description: Sets the selection origin column to the column for the given caret_index. If the selection origin is moved to the caret position, the selection will deselect.

get_selection_from_line.description: Returns the selection begin line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.

get_selection_from_column.description: Returns the selection begin column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.

get_selection_to_line.description: Returns the selection end line. Returns the caret line if there is no selection.

get_selection_to_column.description: Returns the selection end column. Returns the caret column if there is no selection.

is_caret_after_selection_origin.description: Returns true if the caret of the selection is after the selection origin. This can be used to determine the direction of the selection.

is_line_wrapped.description: Returns if the given line is wrapped.

get_line_wrap_count.description: Returns the number of times the given line is wrapped.

get_line_wrap_index_at_column.description: Returns the wrap index of the given column on the given line. This ranges from 0 to get_line_wrap_count.

get_line_wrapped_text.description: Returns an array of s representing each wrapped index.

get_scroll_pos_for_line.description: Returns the scroll position for wrap_index of line.

set_line_as_first_visible.description: Positions the wrap_index of line at the top of the viewport.

set_line_as_center_visible.description: Positions the wrap_index of line at the center of the viewport.

set_line_as_last_visible.description: Positions the wrap_index of line at the bottom of the viewport.

get_last_full_visible_line.description: Returns the last visible line. Use get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index for the wrap index.

get_last_full_visible_line_wrap_index.description: Returns the last visible wrap index of the last visible line.

get_visible_line_count.description: Returns the number of lines that can visually fit, rounded down, based on this control's height.

get_visible_line_count_in_range.description: Returns the total number of lines between from_line and to_line (inclusive) in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If the range covers all lines it is equivalent to get_total_visible_line_count.

get_total_visible_line_count.description: Returns the total number of lines in the text. This includes wrapped lines and excludes folded lines. If wrap_mode is set to  and no lines are folded (see CodeEdit.is_line_folded) then this is equivalent to get_line_count. See get_visible_line_count_in_range for a limited range of lines.

adjust_viewport_to_caret.description: Adjust the viewport so the caret is visible.

center_viewport_to_caret.description: Centers the viewport on the line the editing caret is at. This also resets the scroll_horizontal value to 0.

get_minimap_visible_lines.description: Returns the number of lines that may be drawn on the minimap.

add_gutter.description: Register a new gutter to this . Use at to have a specific gutter order. A value of -1 appends the gutter to the right.

remove_gutter.description: Removes the gutter at the given index.

get_gutter_count.description: Returns the number of gutters registered.

set_gutter_name.description: Sets the name of the gutter at the given index.

get_gutter_name.description: Returns the name of the gutter at the given index.

set_gutter_type.description: Sets the type of gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.

get_gutter_type.description: Returns the type of the gutter at the given index. Gutters can contain icons, text, or custom visuals.

set_gutter_width.description: Set the width of the gutter at the given index.

get_gutter_width.description: Returns the width of the gutter at the given index.

set_gutter_draw.description: If true, the gutter at the given index is drawn. The gutter type (set_gutter_type) determines how it is drawn. See is_gutter_drawn.

is_gutter_drawn.description: Returns true if the gutter at the given index is currently drawn. See set_gutter_draw.

set_gutter_clickable.description: If true, the mouse cursor will change to a pointing hand () when hovering over the gutter at the given index. See is_gutter_clickable and set_line_gutter_clickable.

is_gutter_clickable.description: Returns true if the gutter at the given index is clickable. See set_gutter_clickable.

set_gutter_overwritable.description: If true, the line data of the gutter at the given index can be overridden when using merge_gutters. See is_gutter_overwritable.

is_gutter_overwritable.description: Returns true if the gutter at the given index is overwritable. See set_gutter_overwritable.

merge_gutters.description: Merge the gutters from from_line into to_line. Only overwritable gutters will be copied. See set_gutter_overwritable.

set_gutter_custom_draw.description: Set a custom draw callback for the gutter at the given index. draw_callback must take the following arguments: A line index , a gutter index , and an area . This callback only works when the gutter type is  (see set_gutter_type).

get_total_gutter_width.description: Returns the total width of all gutters and internal padding.

set_line_gutter_metadata.description: Sets the metadata for gutter on line to metadata.

get_line_gutter_metadata.description: Returns the metadata currently in gutter at line.

set_line_gutter_text.description: Sets the text for gutter on line to text. This only works when the gutter type is  (see set_gutter_type).

get_line_gutter_text.description: Returns the text currently in gutter at line. This only works when the gutter type is  (see set_gutter_type).

set_line_gutter_icon.description: Sets the icon for gutter on line to icon. This only works when the gutter type is  (see set_gutter_type).

get_line_gutter_icon.description: Returns the icon currently in gutter at line. This only works when the gutter type is  (see set_gutter_type).

set_line_gutter_item_color.description: Sets the color for gutter on line to color.

get_line_gutter_item_color.description: Returns the color currently in gutter at line.

set_line_gutter_clickable.description: If clickable is true, makes the gutter on the given line clickable. This is like set_gutter_clickable, but for a single line. If is_gutter_clickable is true, this will not have any effect. See is_line_gutter_clickable and .

is_line_gutter_clickable.description: Returns true if the gutter at the given index on the given line is clickable. See set_line_gutter_clickable.

set_line_background_color.description: Sets the custom background color of the given line. If transparent, this color is applied on top of the default background color (See ). If set to Color(0, 0, 0, 0), no additional color is applied.

get_line_background_color.description: Returns the custom background color of the given line. If no color is set, returns Color(0, 0, 0, 0).

is_menu_visible.description: Returns true if the menu is visible. Use this instead of get_menu().visible to improve performance (so the creation of the menu is avoided). See get_menu.

menu_option.description: Executes a given action as defined in the  enum.

get_caret_index_edit_order.description: Returns a list of caret indexes in their edit order, this done from bottom to top. Edit order refers to the way actions such as insert_text_at_caret are applied.

get_selection_line.description: Returns the original start line of the selection.

get_selection_column.description: Returns the original start column of the selection.

placeholder_text.description: Text shown when the  is empty. It is not the 's default value (see text).

editable.description: If false, existing text cannot be modified and new text cannot be added.

context_menu_enabled.description: If true, a right-click displays the context menu.

emoji_menu_enabled.description: If true, "Emoji and Symbols" menu is enabled.

backspace_deletes_composite_character_en.description: If true and caret_mid_grapheme is false, backspace deletes an entire composite character such as ❤️‍🩹, instead of deleting part of the composite character.

shortcut_keys_enabled.description: If true, shortcut keys for context menu items are enabled, even if the context menu is disabled.

selecting_enabled.description:
If true, text can be selected.
			If false, text can not be selected by the user or by the select or select_all methods.

deselect_on_focus_loss_enabled.description: If true, the selected text will be deselected when focus is lost.

drag_and_drop_selection_enabled.description: If true, allow drag and drop of selected text. Text can still be dropped from other sources.

middle_mouse_paste_enabled.description:
If false, using middle mouse button to paste clipboard will be disabled.
			Note: This method is only implemented on Linux.

empty_selection_clipboard_enabled.description: If true, copying or cutting without a selection is performed on all lines with a caret. Otherwise, copy and cut require a selection.

wrap_mode.description: Sets the line wrapping mode to use.

autowrap_mode.description: If wrap_mode is set to , sets text wrapping mode.

indent_wrapped_lines.description: If true, all wrapped lines are indented to the same amount as the unwrapped line.

tab_input_mode.description: If true, ProjectSettings.input/ui_text_indent input Tab character, otherwise it moves keyboard focus to the next  in the scene.

virtual_keyboard_enabled.description: If true, the native virtual keyboard is enabled on platforms that support it.

virtual_keyboard_show_on_focus.description: If true, the native virtual keyboard is shown on focus events on platforms that support it.

scroll_smooth.description: Scroll smoothly over the text rather than jumping to the next location.

scroll_v_scroll_speed.description: Sets the scroll speed with the minimap or when scroll_smooth is enabled.

scroll_past_end_of_file.description: Allow scrolling past the last line into "virtual" space.

scroll_vertical.description: If there is a vertical scrollbar, this determines the current vertical scroll value in line numbers, starting at 0 for the top line.

scroll_horizontal.description: If there is a horizontal scrollbar, this determines the current horizontal scroll value in pixels.

scroll_fit_content_height.description: If true,  will disable vertical scroll and fit minimum height to the number of visible lines. When both this property and scroll_fit_content_width are true, no scrollbars will be displayed.

scroll_fit_content_width.description: If true,  will disable horizontal scroll and fit minimum width to the widest line in the text. When both this property and scroll_fit_content_height are true, no scrollbars will be displayed.

minimap_draw.description: If true, a minimap is shown, providing an outline of your source code. The minimap uses a fixed-width text size.

minimap_width.description: The width, in pixels, of the minimap.

caret_type.description: Set the type of caret to draw.

caret_blink.description: If true, makes the caret blink.

caret_blink_interval.description: The interval at which the caret blinks (in seconds).

caret_draw_when_editable_disabled.description: If true, caret will be visible when editable is disabled.

caret_move_on_right_click.description:
If true, a right-click moves the caret at the mouse position before displaying the context menu.
			If false, the context menu ignores mouse location.

caret_mid_grapheme.description:
Allow moving caret, selecting and removing the individual composite character components.
			Note: Backspace is always removing individual composite character components.

caret_multiple.description: If true, multiple carets are allowed. Left-clicking with Alt adds a new caret. See add_caret and get_caret_count.

use_default_word_separators.description: If false, using Ctrl + Left or Ctrl + Right (Cmd + Left or Cmd + Right on macOS) bindings will stop moving caret only if a space or punctuation is detected. If true, it will also stop the caret if a character is part of !"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\]^`{|}~, the Unicode General Punctuation table, or the Unicode CJK Punctuation table. Useful for subword moving. This behavior also will be applied to the behavior of text selection.

use_custom_word_separators.description: If false, using Ctrl + Left or Ctrl + Right (Cmd + Left or Cmd + Right on macOS) bindings will use the behavior of use_default_word_separators. If true, it will also stop the caret if a character within custom_word_separators is detected. Useful for subword moving. This behavior also will be applied to the behavior of text selection.

custom_word_separators.description: The characters to consider as word delimiters if use_custom_word_separators is true. The characters should be defined without separation, for example #_!.

syntax_highlighter.description:
The syntax highlighter to use.
			Note: A  instance should not be used across multiple  nodes.

highlight_all_occurrences.description: If true, all occurrences of the selected text will be highlighted.

highlight_current_line.description: If true, the line containing the cursor is highlighted.

draw_control_chars.description: If true, control characters are displayed.

draw_tabs.description: If true, the "tab" character will have a visible representation.

draw_spaces.description: If true, the "space" character will have a visible representation.

language.description: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If left empty, the current locale is used instead.

structured_text_bidi_override.description: Set BiDi algorithm override for the structured text.

structured_text_bidi_override_options.description: Set additional options for BiDi override.

TextLine.description: Abstraction over  for handling a single line of text.

clear.description: Clears text line (removes text and inline objects).

get_inferred_direction.description: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.

set_bidi_override.description:
Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
				Override ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each range separately.

add_string.description: Adds text span and font to draw it.

add_object.description: Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text, object is represented as length object replacement characters.

resize_object.description: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.

has_object.description: Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this line.

tab_align.description: Aligns text to the given tab-stops.

get_object_rect.description: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.

get_size.description: Returns size of the bounding box of the text.

get_line_ascent.description: Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).

get_line_descent.description: Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).

get_line_width.description: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.

get_line_underline_position.description: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.
