draw.description: Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_outline.description: Draw text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

hit_test.description: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.

preserve_invalid.description: If set to true text will display invalid characters.

preserve_control.description: If set to true text will display control characters.

alignment.description: Sets text alignment within the line as if the line was horizontal.

flags.description: Line alignment rules. For more info see .

text_overrun_behavior.description: The clipping behavior when the text exceeds the text line's set width.

ellipsis_char.description: Ellipsis character used for text clipping.

TextMesh.description:
Generate a  from the text.
		TextMesh can be generated only when using dynamic fonts with vector glyph contours. Bitmap fonts (including bitmap data in the TrueType/OpenType containers, like color emoji fonts) are not supported.
		The UV layout is arranged in 4 horizontal strips, top to bottom: 40% of the height for the front face, 40% for the back face, 10% for the outer edges and 10% for the inner edges.

text.description:
The text to generate mesh from.
			Note: Due to being a , it doesn't follow the rules of Node.auto_translate_mode. If disabling translation is desired, it should be done manually with Object.set_message_translation.

font.description: Font configuration used to display text.

font_size.description:
Font size of the 's text. This property works in tandem with pixel_size. Higher values will result in a more detailed font, regardless of curve_step and pixel_size. Consider keeping this value below 63 (inclusive) for good performance, and adjust pixel_size as needed to enlarge text.
			Note: Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation, especially with large font sizes and long texts. To change the text's size in real-time efficiently, change the node's Node3D.scale instead.

horizontal_alignment.description: Controls the text's horizontal alignment. Supports left, center, right, and fill (also known as justify).

vertical_alignment.description: Controls the text's vertical alignment. Supports top, center, and bottom.

uppercase.description: If true, all the text displays as UPPERCASE.

line_spacing.description: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.

autowrap_mode.description: If set to something other than , the text gets wrapped inside the node's bounding rectangle. If you resize the node, it will change its height automatically to show all the text.

pixel_size.description:
The size of one pixel's width on the text to scale it in 3D. This property works in tandem with font_size.
			Note: Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation, especially with large font sizes and long texts. To change the text's size in real-time efficiently, change the node's Node3D.scale instead.

curve_step.description:
Step (in pixels) used to approximate Bézier curves. Lower values result in smoother curves, but is slower to generate and render. Consider adjusting this according to the font size and the typical viewing distance.
			Note: Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation, especially with large font sizes and long texts.

depth.description: Depths of the mesh, if set to 0.0 only front surface, is generated, and UV layout is changed to use full texture for the front face only.

width.description: Text width (in pixels), used for fill alignment.

offset.description:
The text drawing offset (in pixels).
			Note: Changing this property will regenerate the mesh, which is a slow operation. To change the text's position in real-time efficiently, change the node's Node3D.position instead.

language.description: Language code used for line-breaking and text shaping algorithms. If left empty, the current locale is used instead.

structured_text_bidi_override.description: Set BiDi algorithm override for the structured text.

structured_text_bidi_override_options.description: Set additional options for BiDi override.

TextParagraph.description: Abstraction over  for handling a single paragraph of text.

clear.description: Clears text paragraph (removes text and inline objects).

get_inferred_direction.description: Returns the text writing direction inferred by the BiDi algorithm.

set_bidi_override.description:
Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
				Override ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each range separately.

set_dropcap.description: Sets drop cap, overrides previously set drop cap. Drop cap (dropped capital) is a decorative element at the beginning of a paragraph that is larger than the rest of the text.

add_string.description: Adds text span and font to draw it.

add_object.description: Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text, object is represented as length object replacement characters.

resize_object.description: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.

has_object.description: Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this shaped text buffer.

tab_align.description: Aligns paragraph to the given tab-stops.

get_non_wrapped_size.description: Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph, without line breaks.

get_size.description: Returns the size of the bounding box of the paragraph.

get_rid.description: Returns TextServer full string buffer RID.

get_dropcap_rid.description: Returns drop cap text buffer RID.

get_range.description: Returns the character range of the paragraph.

get_line_count.description: Returns number of lines in the paragraph.

get_line_objects.description: Returns array of inline objects in the line.

get_line_object_rect.description: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.

get_line_size.description: Returns size of the bounding box of the line of text. Returned size is rounded up.

get_line_range.description: Returns character range of the line.

get_line_ascent.description: Returns the text line ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).

get_line_descent.description: Returns the text line descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).

get_line_width.description: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the line of text.

get_line_underline_position.description: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

get_dropcap_size.description: Returns drop cap bounding box size.

get_dropcap_lines.description: Returns number of lines used by dropcap.

draw.description: Draw all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_outline.description: Draw outlines of all lines of the text and drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_line.description: Draw single line of text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_line_outline.description: Draw outline of the single line of text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_dropcap.description: Draw drop cap into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

draw_dropcap_outline.description: Draw drop cap outline into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the top left corner of the bounding box. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

hit_test.description: Returns caret character offset at the specified coordinates. This function always returns a valid position.

custom_punctuation.description: Custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.

preserve_invalid.description: If set to true text will display invalid characters.

preserve_control.description: If set to true text will display control characters.

break_flags.description: Line breaking rules. For more info see .

text_overrun_behavior.description: The clipping behavior when the text exceeds the paragraph's set width.

ellipsis_char.description: Ellipsis character used for text clipping.

max_lines_visible.description: Limits the lines of text shown.

line_spacing.description: Additional vertical spacing between lines (in pixels), spacing is added to line descent. This value can be negative.

TextServer.brief_description: A server interface for font management and text rendering.

has_feature.description: Returns true if the server supports a feature.

get_name.description: Returns the name of the server interface.

load_support_data.description:
Loads optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).
				Note: This function should be called before any other TextServer functions used, otherwise it won't have any effect.

get_support_data_filename.description: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) filename.

get_support_data_info.description: Returns TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) description.

save_support_data.description:
Saves optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) to the file.
				Note: This function is used by during project export, to include TextServer database.

get_support_data.description: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).

is_locale_using_support_data.description: Returns true if the locale requires text server support data for line/word breaking.

is_locale_right_to_left.description: Returns true if locale is right-to-left.

name_to_tag.description: Converts the given readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language to an OpenType tag.

tag_to_name.description: Converts the given OpenType tag to the readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language.

has.description: Returns true if rid is valid resource owned by this text server.

free_rid.description: Frees an object created by this .

create_font.description: Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource. To free the resulting resource, use the free_rid method.

create_font_linked_variation.description: Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph cache and font data. To free the resulting resource, use the free_rid method.

font_set_data.description: Sets font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.

font_set_face_index.description: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

font_get_face_index.description: Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

font_get_face_count.description: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

font_set_style.description:
Sets the font style flags.
				Note: This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use font_set_face_index, font_set_variation_coordinates, font_set_embolden, or font_set_transform instead.

font_get_ot_name_strings.description: Returns  with OpenType font name strings (localized font names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).

font_set_weight.description:
Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.
				Note: This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use font_set_face_index, font_set_variation_coordinates, or font_set_embolden instead.

font_get_weight.description: Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.

font_set_stretch.description:
Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.
				Note: This value is used for font matching only and will not affect font rendering. Use font_set_face_index, font_set_variation_coordinates, or font_set_transform instead.

font_get_stretch.description: Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.

font_set_disable_embedded_bitmaps.description: If set to true, embedded font bitmap loading is disabled (bitmap-only and color fonts ignore this property).

font_get_disable_embedded_bitmaps.description: Returns whether the font's embedded bitmap loading is disabled.

font_set_generate_mipmaps.description: If set to true font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

font_get_generate_mipmaps.description: Returns true if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

font_set_multichannel_signed_distance_fi.description:
If set to true, glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on the CPU). As a downside, font hinting is not available with MSDF. The lack of font hinting may result in less crisp and less readable fonts at small sizes.
				Note: MSDF font rendering does not render glyphs with overlapping shapes correctly. Overlapping shapes are not valid per the OpenType standard, but are still commonly found in many font files, especially those converted by Google Fonts. To avoid issues with overlapping glyphs, consider downloading the font file directly from the type foundry instead of relying on Google Fonts.

font_is_multichannel_signed_distance_fie.description: Returns true if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.

font_set_msdf_pixel_range.description: Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

font_get_msdf_pixel_range.description: Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

font_set_msdf_size.description: Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

font_get_msdf_size.description: Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

font_set_fixed_size.description: Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same cache entry will be used for all font sizes.

font_set_fixed_size_scale_mode.description: Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if fixed_size is greater than zero.

font_set_allow_system_fallback.description: If set to true, system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

font_is_allow_system_fallback.description: Returns true if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

font_clear_system_fallback_cache.description: Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.

font_set_force_autohinter.description: If set to true auto-hinting is preferred over font built-in hinting.

font_is_force_autohinter.description: Returns true if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_set_modulate_color_glyphs.description: If set to true, color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.

font_is_modulate_color_glyphs.description: Returns true if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's colored glyphs.

font_set_hinting.description: Sets font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_get_hinting.description: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_set_subpixel_positioning.description: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

font_get_subpixel_positioning.description: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

font_set_keep_rounding_remainders.description: Sets glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

font_get_keep_rounding_remainders.description: Returns glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

font_set_embolden.description: Sets font embolden strength. If strength is not equal to zero, emboldens the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.

font_set_spacing.description: Sets the spacing for spacing to value in pixels (not relative to the font size).

font_get_spacing.description: Returns the spacing for spacing in pixels (not relative to the font size).

font_set_baseline_offset.description: Sets extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

font_get_baseline_offset.description: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

font_set_transform.description:
Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs.
				For example, to simulate italic typeface by slanting, apply the following transform Transform2D(1.0, slant, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0).

font_get_transform.description: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.

font_set_variation_coordinates.description: Sets variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See font_supported_variation_list for more info.

font_get_variation_coordinates.description: Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry. See font_supported_variation_list for more info.

font_set_oversampling.description: If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_get_oversampling.description: Returns oversampling factor override. If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.

font_get_size_cache_list.description: Returns list of the font sizes in the cache. Each size is  with font size and outline size.

font_clear_size_cache.description: Removes all font sizes from the cache entry.

font_remove_size_cache.description: Removes specified font size from the cache entry.

font_get_size_cache_info.description: Returns font cache information, each entry contains the following fields: Vector2i size_px - font size in pixels, float viewport_oversampling - viewport oversampling factor, int glyphs - number of rendered glyphs, int textures - number of used textures, int textures_size - size of texture data in bytes.

font_set_ascent.description: Sets the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).

font_get_ascent.description: Returns the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).

font_set_descent.description: Sets the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).

font_get_descent.description: Returns the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).

font_set_underline_position.description: Sets pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

font_get_underline_position.description: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

font_set_underline_thickness.description: Sets thickness of the underline in pixels.

font_get_underline_thickness.description: Returns thickness of the underline in pixels.

font_set_scale.description: Sets scaling factor of the color bitmap font.

font_get_scale.description: Returns scaling factor of the color bitmap font.

font_get_texture_count.description: Returns number of textures used by font cache entry.

font_clear_textures.description:
Removes all textures from font cache entry.
				Note: This function will not remove glyphs associated with the texture, use font_remove_glyph to remove them manually.

font_remove_texture.description:
Removes specified texture from the cache entry.
				Note: This function will not remove glyphs associated with the texture, remove them manually, using font_remove_glyph.

font_set_texture_image.description: Sets font cache texture image data.

font_get_texture_image.description: Returns font cache texture image data.

font_set_texture_offsets.description: Sets array containing glyph packing data.

font_get_texture_offsets.description: Returns array containing glyph packing data.

font_get_glyph_list.description: Returns list of rendered glyphs in the cache entry.

font_clear_glyphs.description:
Removes all rendered glyph information from the cache entry.
				Note: This function will not remove textures associated with the glyphs, use font_remove_texture to remove them manually.

font_remove_glyph.description:
Removes specified rendered glyph information from the cache entry.
				Note: This function will not remove textures associated with the glyphs, use font_remove_texture to remove them manually.

font_get_glyph_advance.description:
Returns glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).
				Note: Advance for glyphs outlines is the same as the base glyph advance and is not saved.

font_set_glyph_advance.description:
Sets glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).
				Note: Advance for glyphs outlines is the same as the base glyph advance and is not saved.

font_get_glyph_offset.description: Returns glyph offset from the baseline.

font_set_glyph_offset.description: Sets glyph offset from the baseline.

font_get_glyph_uv_rect.description: Returns rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.

font_set_glyph_uv_rect.description: Sets rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.

font_get_glyph_texture_idx.description: Returns index of the cache texture containing the glyph.

font_set_glyph_texture_idx.description: Sets index of the cache texture containing the glyph.

font_get_glyph_texture_rid.description:
Returns resource ID of the cache texture containing the glyph.
				Note: If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.

font_get_glyph_texture_size.description:
Returns size of the cache texture containing the glyph.
				Note: If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.

font_get_glyph_contours.description:
Returns outline contours of the glyph as a  with the following contents:
				points         - , containing outline points. x and y are point coordinates. z is the type of the point, using the  values.
				contours       - , containing indices the end points of each contour.
				orientation    - , contour orientation. If true, clockwise contours must be filled.
				- Two successive  points indicate a line segment.
				- One  point between two  points indicates a single conic (quadratic) Bézier arc.
				- Two  points between two  points indicate a single cubic Bézier arc.
				- Two successive  points indicate two successive conic (quadratic) Bézier arcs with a virtual  point at their middle.
				- Each contour is closed. The last point of a contour uses the first point of a contour as its next point, and vice versa. The first point can be  point.

font_get_kerning_list.description: Returns list of the kerning overrides.

font_remove_kerning.description: Removes kerning override for the pair of glyphs.

font_set_kerning.description: Sets kerning for the pair of glyphs.

font_get_kerning.description: Returns kerning for the pair of glyphs.

font_get_glyph_index.description: Returns the glyph index of a char, optionally modified by the variation_selector. See font_get_char_from_glyph_index.

font_get_char_from_glyph_index.description: Returns character code associated with glyph_index, or 0 if glyph_index is invalid. See font_get_glyph_index.

font_has_char.description: Returns true if a Unicode char is available in the font.

font_get_supported_chars.description: Returns a string containing all the characters available in the font.

font_get_supported_glyphs.description: Returns an array containing all glyph indices in the font.

font_render_range.description: Renders the range of characters to the font cache texture.

font_render_glyph.description: Renders specified glyph to the font cache texture.

font_draw_glyph.description:
Draws single glyph into a canvas item at the position, using font_rid at the size size. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
				Note: Glyph index is specific to the font, use glyphs indices returned by shaped_text_get_glyphs or font_get_glyph_index.
				Note: If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.

font_draw_glyph_outline.description:
Draws single glyph outline of size outline_size into a canvas item at the position, using font_rid at the size size. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
				Note: Glyph index is specific to the font, use glyphs indices returned by shaped_text_get_glyphs or font_get_glyph_index.
				Note: If there are pending glyphs to render, calling this function might trigger the texture cache update.

font_is_language_supported.description: Returns true if the font supports the given language (as a ISO 639 code).

font_get_language_support_override.description: Returns true if support override is enabled for the language.

font_get_language_support_overrides.description: Returns list of language support overrides.

font_is_script_supported.description: Returns true if the font supports the given script (as a ISO 15924 code).

font_get_script_support_override.description: Returns true if support override is enabled for the script.

font_get_script_support_overrides.description: Returns list of script support overrides.

font_set_opentype_feature_overrides.description: Sets font OpenType feature set override.

font_get_opentype_feature_overrides.description: Returns font OpenType feature set override.

font_supported_feature_list.description: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType features.

font_supported_variation_list.description: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType variation coordinates.

font_get_global_oversampling.description: This method does nothing and always returns 1.0.

get_hex_code_box_size.description: Returns size of the replacement character (box with character hexadecimal code that is drawn in place of invalid characters).

draw_hex_code_box.description: Draws box displaying character hexadecimal code. Used for replacing missing characters.

create_shaped_text.description:
Creates a new buffer for complex text layout, with the given direction and orientation. To free the resulting buffer, use free_rid method.
				Note: Direction is ignored if server does not support  feature (supported by ).
				Note: Orientation is ignored if server does not support  feature (supported by ).

shaped_text_clear.description: Clears text buffer (removes text and inline objects).

shaped_text_set_direction.description:
Sets desired text direction. If set to , direction will be detected based on the buffer contents and current locale.
				Note: Direction is ignored if server does not support  feature (supported by ).

shaped_text_get_inferred_direction.description: Returns direction of the text, inferred by the BiDi algorithm.

shaped_text_set_bidi_override.description:
Overrides BiDi for the structured text.
				Override ranges should cover full source text without overlaps. BiDi algorithm will be used on each range separately.

shaped_text_set_custom_punctuation.description: Sets custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.

shaped_text_get_custom_punctuation.description: Returns custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.

shaped_text_set_custom_ellipsis.description: Sets ellipsis character used for text clipping.

shaped_text_get_custom_ellipsis.description: Returns ellipsis character used for text clipping.

shaped_text_set_orientation.description:
Sets desired text orientation.
				Note: Orientation is ignored if server does not support  feature (supported by ).

shaped_text_set_preserve_invalid.description: If set to true text buffer will display invalid characters as hexadecimal codes, otherwise nothing is displayed.

shaped_text_get_preserve_invalid.description:
Returns true if text buffer is configured to display hexadecimal codes in place of invalid characters.
				Note: If set to false, nothing is displayed in place of invalid characters.

shaped_text_set_preserve_control.description: If set to true text buffer will display control characters.

shaped_text_get_preserve_control.description: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display control characters.

shaped_text_set_spacing.description: Sets extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.

shaped_text_get_spacing.description: Returns extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.

shaped_text_add_string.description: Adds text span and font to draw it to the text buffer.

shaped_text_add_object.description: Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text, object is represented as length object replacement characters.

shaped_text_resize_object.description: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.

shaped_text_has_object.description: Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this shaped text buffer.

shaped_get_text.description: Returns the text buffer source text, including object replacement characters.

shaped_get_span_count.description: Returns number of text spans added using shaped_text_add_string or shaped_text_add_object.

shaped_get_span_text.description: Returns the text span source text.

shaped_get_span_object.description: Returns the text span embedded object key.

shaped_set_span_update_font.description: Changes text span font, font size, and OpenType features, without changing the text.

shaped_get_run_count.description: Returns the number of uniform text runs in the buffer.

shaped_get_run_text.description: Returns the source text of the index text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_range.description: Returns the source text range of the index text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_font_rid.description: Returns the font RID of the index text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_font_size.description: Returns the font size of the index text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_language.description: Returns the language of the index text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_direction.description: Returns the direction of the index text run (in visual order).

shaped_get_run_object.description: Returns the embedded object of the index text run (in visual order).

shaped_text_substr.description: Returns text buffer for the substring of the text in the shaped text buffer (including inline objects).

shaped_text_get_parent.description: Returns the parent buffer from which the substring originates.

shaped_text_fit_to_width.description: Adjusts text width to fit to specified width, returns new text width.

shaped_text_tab_align.description: Aligns shaped text to the given tab-stops.

shaped_text_shape.description:
Shapes buffer if it's not shaped. Returns true if the string is shaped successfully.
				Note: It is not necessary to call this function manually, buffer will be shaped automatically as soon as any of its output data is requested.

shaped_text_is_ready.description: Returns true if buffer is successfully shaped.

shaped_text_has_visible_chars.description: Returns true if text buffer contains any visible characters.

shaped_text_get_glyphs.description: Returns an array of glyphs in the visual order.

shaped_text_sort_logical.description: Returns text glyphs in the logical order.

shaped_text_get_glyph_count.description: Returns number of glyphs in the buffer.

shaped_text_get_range.description: Returns substring buffer character range in the parent buffer.

shaped_text_get_line_breaks_adv.description: Breaks text to the lines and columns. Returns character ranges for each segment.

shaped_text_get_line_breaks.description: Breaks text to the lines and returns character ranges for each line.

shaped_text_get_word_breaks.description: Breaks text into words and returns array of character ranges. Use grapheme_flags to set what characters are used for breaking.

shaped_text_get_trim_pos.description: Returns the position of the overrun trim.

shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyphs.description: Returns array of the glyphs in the ellipsis.

shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyph_count.description: Returns number of glyphs in the ellipsis.

shaped_text_overrun_trim_to_width.description: Trims text if it exceeds the given width.

shaped_text_get_object_rect.description: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.

shaped_text_get_object_range.description: Returns the character range of the inline object.

shaped_text_get_object_glyph.description: Returns the glyph index of the inline object.

shaped_text_get_ascent.description:
Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).
				Note: Overall ascent can be higher than font ascent, if some glyphs are displaced from the baseline.

shaped_text_get_descent.description:
Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).
				Note: Overall descent can be higher than font descent, if some glyphs are displaced from the baseline.

shaped_text_get_width.description: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.

shaped_text_get_underline_position.description: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

shaped_text_get_carets.description: Returns shapes of the carets corresponding to the character offset position in the text. Returned caret shape is 1 pixel wide rectangle.

shaped_text_get_selection.description: Returns selection rectangles for the specified character range.

shaped_text_hit_test_grapheme.description: Returns grapheme index at the specified pixel offset at the baseline, or -1 if none is found.

shaped_text_hit_test_position.description: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.

shaped_text_get_grapheme_bounds.description: Returns composite character's bounds as offsets from the start of the line.

shaped_text_next_grapheme_pos.description: Returns grapheme end position closest to the pos.

shaped_text_prev_grapheme_pos.description: Returns grapheme start position closest to the pos.

shaped_text_get_character_breaks.description: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.

shaped_text_next_character_pos.description: Returns composite character end position closest to the pos.

shaped_text_prev_character_pos.description: Returns composite character start position closest to the pos.

shaped_text_closest_character_pos.description: Returns composite character position closest to the pos.

shaped_text_draw.description:
Draw shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
				clip_l and clip_r are offsets relative to pos, going to the right in horizontal layout and downward in vertical layout. If clip_l is not negative, glyphs starting before the offset are clipped. If clip_r is not negative, glyphs ending after the offset are clipped.

shaped_text_draw_outline.description:
Draw the outline of the shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.
				clip_l and clip_r are offsets relative to pos, going to the right in horizontal layout and downward in vertical layout. If clip_l is not negative, glyphs starting before the offset are clipped. If clip_r is not negative, glyphs ending after the offset are clipped.

shaped_text_get_dominant_direction_in_ra.description: Returns dominant direction of in the range of text.

format_number.description:
Converts a number from Western Arabic (0..9) to the numeral system used in the given language.
				If language is an empty string, the active locale will be used.

parse_number.description:
Converts number from the numeral system used in the given language to Western Arabic (0..9).
				If language is an empty string, the active locale will be used.

percent_sign.description:
Returns the percent sign used in the given language.
				If language is an empty string, the active locale will be used.

string_get_word_breaks.description:
Returns an array of the word break boundaries. Elements in the returned array are the offsets of the start and end of words. Therefore the length of the array is always even.
				When chars_per_line is greater than zero, line break boundaries are returned instead.
				
				var ts = TextServerManager.get_primary_interface()
				# Corresponds to the substrings "The", "Godot", "Engine", and "4".
				print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4")) # Prints 
				# Corresponds to the substrings "The", "Godot", "Engin", and "e, 4".
				print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4", "en", 5)) # Prints 
				# Corresponds to the substrings "The Godot" and "Engine, 4".
				print(ts.string_get_word_breaks("The Godot Engine, 4", "en", 10)) # Prints

is_confusable.description:
Returns index of the first string in dict which is visually confusable with the string, or -1 if none is found.
				Note: This method doesn't detect invisible characters, for spoof detection use it in combination with spoof_check.
				Note: Always returns -1 if the server does not support the  feature.

spoof_check.description:
Returns true if string is likely to be an attempt at confusing the reader.
				Note: Always returns false if the server does not support the  feature.

strip_diacritics.description:
Strips diacritics from the string.
				Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

is_valid_identifier.description:
Returns true if string is a valid identifier.
				If the text server supports the  feature, a valid identifier must:
				- Conform to normalization form C.
				- Begin with a Unicode character of class XID_Start or "_".
				- May contain Unicode characters of class XID_Continue in the other positions.
				- Use UAX #31 recommended scripts only (mixed scripts are allowed).
				If the  feature is not supported, a valid identifier must:
				- Begin with a Unicode character of class XID_Start or "_".
				- May contain Unicode characters of class XID_Continue in the other positions.

is_valid_letter.description: Returns true if the given code point is a valid letter, i.e. it belongs to the Unicode category "L".

string_to_upper.description:
Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE.
				Note: Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support  feature (supported by ).
				Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

string_to_lower.description:
Returns the string converted to lowercase.
				Note: Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support  feature (supported by ).
				Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

string_to_title.description:
Returns the string converted to Title Case.
				Note: Casing is locale dependent and context sensitive if server support  feature (supported by ).
				Note: The result may be longer or shorter than the original.

parse_structured_text.description: Default implementation of the BiDi algorithm override function.

TextServerDummy.brief_description: A dummy text server that can't render text or manage fonts.

TextServerExtension.description: External  implementations should inherit from this class.

_has_feature.description: Returns true if the server supports a feature.

_get_name.description: Returns the name of the server interface.

_free_rid.description: Frees an object created by this .

_has.description: Returns true if rid is valid resource owned by this text server.

_load_support_data.description: Loads optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).

_get_support_data_filename.description: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) filename.

_get_support_data_info.description: Returns TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) description.

_save_support_data.description: Saves optional TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries) to the file.

_get_support_data.description: Returns default TextServer database (e.g. ICU break iterators and dictionaries).

_is_locale_using_support_data.description: Returns true if the locale requires text server support data for line/word breaking.

_is_locale_right_to_left.description: Returns true if locale is right-to-left.

_name_to_tag.description: Converts the given readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language to an OpenType tag.

_tag_to_name.description: Converts the given OpenType tag to the readable name of a feature, variation, script, or language.

_create_font.description: Creates a new, empty font cache entry resource.

_create_font_linked_variation.description:
Optional, implement if font supports extra spacing or baseline offset.
				Creates a new variation existing font which is reusing the same glyph cache and font data.

_font_set_data.description: Sets font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.

_font_set_data_ptr.description: Sets pointer to the font source data, e.g contents of the dynamic font source file.

_font_set_face_index.description: Sets an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

_font_get_face_index.description: Returns an active face index in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

_font_get_face_count.description: Returns number of faces in the TrueType / OpenType collection.

_font_get_ot_name_strings.description: Returns  with OpenType font name strings (localized font names, version, description, license information, sample text, etc.).

_font_set_weight.description: Sets weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.

_font_get_weight.description: Returns weight (boldness) of the font. A value in the 100...999 range, normal font weight is 400, bold font weight is 700.

_font_set_stretch.description: Sets font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.

_font_get_stretch.description: Returns font stretch amount, compared to a normal width. A percentage value between 50% and 200%.

_font_set_disable_embedded_bitmaps.description: If set to true, embedded font bitmap loading is disabled.

_font_get_disable_embedded_bitmaps.description: Returns whether the font's embedded bitmap loading is disabled.

_font_set_generate_mipmaps.description: If set to true font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

_font_get_generate_mipmaps.description: Returns true if font texture mipmap generation is enabled.

_font_set_multichannel_signed_distance_f.description: If set to true, glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data. MSDF rendering allows displaying the font at any scaling factor without blurriness, and without incurring a CPU cost when the font size changes (since the font no longer needs to be rasterized on the CPU). As a downside, font hinting is not available with MSDF. The lack of font hinting may result in less crisp and less readable fonts at small sizes.

_font_is_multichannel_signed_distance_fi.description: Returns true if glyphs of all sizes are rendered using single multichannel signed distance field generated from the dynamic font vector data.

_font_set_msdf_pixel_range.description: Sets the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

_font_get_msdf_pixel_range.description: Returns the width of the range around the shape between the minimum and maximum representable signed distance.

_font_set_msdf_size.description: Sets source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

_font_get_msdf_size.description: Returns source font size used to generate MSDF textures.

_font_set_fixed_size.description: Sets bitmap font fixed size. If set to value greater than zero, same cache entry will be used for all font sizes.

_font_set_fixed_size_scale_mode.description: Sets bitmap font scaling mode. This property is used only if fixed_size is greater than zero.

_font_set_allow_system_fallback.description: If set to true, system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

_font_is_allow_system_fallback.description: Returns true if system fonts can be automatically used as fallbacks.

_font_clear_system_fallback_cache.description: Frees all automatically loaded system fonts.

_font_set_force_autohinter.description: If set to true auto-hinting is preferred over font built-in hinting.

_font_is_force_autohinter.description: Returns true if auto-hinting is supported and preferred over font built-in hinting.

_font_set_modulate_color_glyphs.description: If set to true, color modulation is applied when drawing colored glyphs, otherwise it's applied to the monochrome glyphs only.

_font_is_modulate_color_glyphs.description: Returns true if color modulation is applied when drawing the font's colored glyphs.

_font_set_hinting.description: Sets font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

_font_get_hinting.description: Returns the font hinting mode. Used by dynamic fonts only.

_font_set_subpixel_positioning.description: Sets font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

_font_get_subpixel_positioning.description: Returns font subpixel glyph positioning mode.

_font_set_keep_rounding_remainders.description: Sets glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

_font_get_keep_rounding_remainders.description: Returns glyph position rounding behavior. If set to true, when aligning glyphs to the pixel boundaries rounding remainders are accumulated to ensure more uniform glyph distribution. This setting has no effect if subpixel positioning is enabled.

_font_set_embolden.description: Sets font embolden strength. If strength is not equal to zero, emboldens the font outlines. Negative values reduce the outline thickness.

_font_set_spacing.description: Sets the spacing for spacing to value in pixels (not relative to the font size).

_font_get_spacing.description: Returns the spacing for spacing in pixels (not relative to the font size).

_font_set_baseline_offset.description: Sets extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

_font_get_baseline_offset.description: Returns extra baseline offset (as a fraction of font height).

_font_set_transform.description: Sets 2D transform, applied to the font outlines, can be used for slanting, flipping, and rotating glyphs.

_font_get_transform.description: Returns 2D transform applied to the font outlines.

_font_set_variation_coordinates.description: Sets variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry.

_font_get_variation_coordinates.description: Returns variation coordinates for the specified font cache entry.

_font_set_oversampling.description: If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.

_font_get_oversampling.description: Returns oversampling factor override. If set to a positive value, overrides the oversampling factor of the viewport this font is used in. See Viewport.oversampling. This value doesn't override the oversampling parameter of draw_* methods. Used by dynamic fonts only.

_font_get_size_cache_list.description: Returns list of the font sizes in the cache. Each size is  with font size and outline size.

_font_clear_size_cache.description: Removes all font sizes from the cache entry.

_font_remove_size_cache.description: Removes specified font size from the cache entry.

_font_get_size_cache_info.description: Returns font cache information, each entry contains the following fields: Vector2i size_px - font size in pixels, float viewport_oversampling - viewport oversampling factor, int glyphs - number of rendered glyphs, int textures - number of used textures, int textures_size - size of texture data in bytes.

_font_set_ascent.description: Sets the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).

_font_get_ascent.description: Returns the font ascent (number of pixels above the baseline).

_font_set_descent.description: Sets the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).

_font_get_descent.description: Returns the font descent (number of pixels below the baseline).

_font_set_underline_position.description: Sets pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

_font_get_underline_position.description: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

_font_set_underline_thickness.description: Sets thickness of the underline in pixels.

_font_get_underline_thickness.description: Returns thickness of the underline in pixels.

_font_set_scale.description: Sets scaling factor of the color bitmap font.

_font_get_scale.description: Returns scaling factor of the color bitmap font.

_font_get_texture_count.description: Returns number of textures used by font cache entry.

_font_clear_textures.description: Removes all textures from font cache entry.

_font_remove_texture.description: Removes specified texture from the cache entry.

_font_set_texture_image.description: Sets font cache texture image data.

_font_get_texture_image.description: Returns font cache texture image data.

_font_set_texture_offsets.description: Sets array containing glyph packing data.

_font_get_texture_offsets.description: Returns array containing glyph packing data.

_font_get_glyph_list.description: Returns list of rendered glyphs in the cache entry.

_font_clear_glyphs.description: Removes all rendered glyph information from the cache entry.

_font_remove_glyph.description: Removes specified rendered glyph information from the cache entry.

_font_get_glyph_advance.description: Returns glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).

_font_set_glyph_advance.description: Sets glyph advance (offset of the next glyph).

_font_get_glyph_offset.description: Returns glyph offset from the baseline.

_font_set_glyph_offset.description: Sets glyph offset from the baseline.

_font_get_glyph_uv_rect.description: Returns rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_set_glyph_uv_rect.description: Sets rectangle in the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_get_glyph_texture_idx.description: Returns index of the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_set_glyph_texture_idx.description: Sets index of the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_get_glyph_texture_rid.description: Returns resource ID of the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_get_glyph_texture_size.description: Returns size of the cache texture containing the glyph.

_font_get_glyph_contours.description: Returns outline contours of the glyph.

_font_get_kerning_list.description: Returns list of the kerning overrides.

_font_remove_kerning.description: Removes kerning override for the pair of glyphs.

_font_set_kerning.description: Sets kerning for the pair of glyphs.

_font_get_kerning.description: Returns kerning for the pair of glyphs.

_font_get_glyph_index.description: Returns the glyph index of a char, optionally modified by the variation_selector.

_font_get_char_from_glyph_index.description: Returns character code associated with glyph_index, or 0 if glyph_index is invalid.

_font_has_char.description: Returns true if a Unicode char is available in the font.

_font_get_supported_chars.description: Returns a string containing all the characters available in the font.

_font_get_supported_glyphs.description: Returns an array containing all glyph indices in the font.

_font_render_range.description: Renders the range of characters to the font cache texture.

_font_render_glyph.description: Renders specified glyph to the font cache texture.

_font_draw_glyph.description: Draws single glyph into a canvas item at the position, using font_rid at the size size. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

_font_draw_glyph_outline.description: Draws single glyph outline of size outline_size into a canvas item at the position, using font_rid at the size size. If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

_font_is_language_supported.description: Returns true if the font supports the given language (as a ISO 639 code).

_font_get_language_support_override.description: Returns true if support override is enabled for the language.

_font_get_language_support_overrides.description: Returns list of language support overrides.

_font_is_script_supported.description: Returns true if the font supports the given script (as a ISO 15924 code).

_font_get_script_support_override.description: Returns true if support override is enabled for the script.

_font_get_script_support_overrides.description: Returns list of script support overrides.

_font_set_opentype_feature_overrides.description: Sets font OpenType feature set override.

_font_get_opentype_feature_overrides.description: Returns font OpenType feature set override.

_font_supported_feature_list.description: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType features.

_font_supported_variation_list.description: Returns the dictionary of the supported OpenType variation coordinates.

_font_get_global_oversampling.description: Returns the font oversampling factor, shared by all fonts in the TextServer.

_font_set_global_oversampling.description: Sets oversampling factor, shared by all font in the TextServer.

_reference_oversampling_level.description: Increases the reference count of the specified oversampling level. This method is called by , and should not be used directly.

_unreference_oversampling_level.description: Decreases the reference count of the specified oversampling level, and frees the font cache for oversampling level when the reference count reaches zero. This method is called by , and should not be used directly.

_get_hex_code_box_size.description: Returns size of the replacement character (box with character hexadecimal code that is drawn in place of invalid characters).

_draw_hex_code_box.description: Draws box displaying character hexadecimal code.

_create_shaped_text.description: Creates a new buffer for complex text layout, with the given direction and orientation.

_shaped_text_clear.description: Clears text buffer (removes text and inline objects).

_shaped_text_set_direction.description: Sets desired text direction. If set to , direction will be detected based on the buffer contents and current locale.

_shaped_text_get_inferred_direction.description: Returns direction of the text, inferred by the BiDi algorithm.

_shaped_text_set_bidi_override.description: Overrides BiDi for the structured text.

_shaped_text_set_custom_punctuation.description: Sets custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.

_shaped_text_get_custom_punctuation.description: Returns custom punctuation character list, used for word breaking. If set to empty string, server defaults are used.

_shaped_text_set_custom_ellipsis.description: Sets ellipsis character used for text clipping.

_shaped_text_get_custom_ellipsis.description: Returns ellipsis character used for text clipping.

_shaped_text_set_preserve_invalid.description: If set to true text buffer will display invalid characters as hexadecimal codes, otherwise nothing is displayed.

_shaped_text_get_preserve_invalid.description: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display hexadecimal codes in place of invalid characters.

_shaped_text_set_preserve_control.description: If set to true text buffer will display control characters.

_shaped_text_get_preserve_control.description: Returns true if text buffer is configured to display control characters.

_shaped_text_set_spacing.description: Sets extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.

_shaped_text_get_spacing.description: Returns extra spacing added between glyphs or lines in pixels.

_shaped_text_add_string.description: Adds text span and font to draw it to the text buffer.

_shaped_text_add_object.description: Adds inline object to the text buffer, key must be unique. In the text, object is represented as length object replacement characters.

_shaped_text_resize_object.description: Sets new size and alignment of embedded object.

_shaped_text_has_object.description: Returns true if an object with key is embedded in this shaped text buffer.

_shaped_get_text.description: Returns the text buffer source text, including object replacement characters.

_shaped_get_span_count.description: Returns number of text spans added using _shaped_text_add_string or _shaped_text_add_object.

_shaped_get_span_text.description: Returns the text span source text.

_shaped_get_span_object.description: Returns the text span embedded object key.

_shaped_set_span_update_font.description: Changes text span font, font size, and OpenType features, without changing the text.

_shaped_get_run_count.description: Returns the number of uniform text runs in the buffer.

_shaped_get_run_text.description: Returns the source text of the index text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_range.description: Returns the source text range of the index text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_font_rid.description: Returns the font RID of the index text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_font_size.description: Returns the font size of the index text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_language.description: Returns the language of the index text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_direction.description: Returns the direction of the index text run (in visual order).

_shaped_get_run_object.description: Returns the embedded object of the index text run (in visual order).

_shaped_text_substr.description: Returns text buffer for the substring of the text in the shaped text buffer (including inline objects).

_shaped_text_get_parent.description: Returns the parent buffer from which the substring originates.

_shaped_text_fit_to_width.description: Adjusts text width to fit to specified width, returns new text width.

_shaped_text_tab_align.description: Aligns shaped text to the given tab-stops.

_shaped_text_shape.description: Shapes buffer if it's not shaped. Returns true if the string is shaped successfully.

_shaped_text_update_breaks.description: Updates break points in the shaped text. This method is called by default implementation of text breaking functions.

_shaped_text_update_justification_ops.description: Updates justification points in the shaped text. This method is called by default implementation of text justification functions.

_shaped_text_is_ready.description: Returns true if buffer is successfully shaped.

_shaped_text_get_glyphs.description: Returns an array of glyphs in the visual order.

_shaped_text_sort_logical.description: Returns text glyphs in the logical order.

_shaped_text_get_glyph_count.description: Returns number of glyphs in the buffer.

_shaped_text_get_range.description: Returns substring buffer character range in the parent buffer.

_shaped_text_get_line_breaks_adv.description: Breaks text to the lines and columns. Returns character ranges for each segment.

_shaped_text_get_line_breaks.description: Breaks text to the lines and returns character ranges for each line.

_shaped_text_get_word_breaks.description: Breaks text into words and returns array of character ranges. Use grapheme_flags to set what characters are used for breaking.

_shaped_text_get_trim_pos.description: Returns the position of the overrun trim.

_shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyph_count.description: Returns number of glyphs in the ellipsis.

_shaped_text_get_ellipsis_glyphs.description: Returns array of the glyphs in the ellipsis.

_shaped_text_overrun_trim_to_width.description: Trims text if it exceeds the given width.

_shaped_text_get_object_rect.description: Returns bounding rectangle of the inline object.

_shaped_text_get_object_range.description: Returns the character range of the inline object.

_shaped_text_get_object_glyph.description: Returns the glyph index of the inline object.

_shaped_text_get_ascent.description: Returns the text ascent (number of pixels above the baseline for horizontal layout or to the left of baseline for vertical).

_shaped_text_get_descent.description: Returns the text descent (number of pixels below the baseline for horizontal layout or to the right of baseline for vertical).

_shaped_text_get_width.description: Returns width (for horizontal layout) or height (for vertical) of the text.

_shaped_text_get_underline_position.description: Returns pixel offset of the underline below the baseline.

_shaped_text_get_dominant_direction_in_r.description: Returns dominant direction of in the range of text.

_shaped_text_get_carets.description: Returns shapes of the carets corresponding to the character offset position in the text. Returned caret shape is 1 pixel wide rectangle.

_shaped_text_get_selection.description: Returns selection rectangles for the specified character range.

_shaped_text_hit_test_grapheme.description: Returns grapheme index at the specified pixel offset at the baseline, or -1 if none is found.

_shaped_text_hit_test_position.description: Returns caret character offset at the specified pixel offset at the baseline. This function always returns a valid position.

_shaped_text_draw.description: Draw shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

_shaped_text_draw_outline.description: Draw the outline of the shaped text into a canvas item at a given position, with color. pos specifies the leftmost point of the baseline (for horizontal layout) or topmost point of the baseline (for vertical layout). If oversampling is greater than zero, it is used as font oversampling factor, otherwise viewport oversampling settings are used.

_shaped_text_get_grapheme_bounds.description: Returns composite character's bounds as offsets from the start of the line.

_shaped_text_next_grapheme_pos.description: Returns grapheme end position closest to the pos.

_shaped_text_prev_grapheme_pos.description: Returns grapheme start position closest to the pos.

_shaped_text_get_character_breaks.description: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.

_shaped_text_next_character_pos.description: Returns composite character end position closest to the pos.

_shaped_text_prev_character_pos.description: Returns composite character start position closest to the pos.

_shaped_text_closest_character_pos.description: Returns composite character position closest to the pos.

_percent_sign.description: Returns percent sign used in the given language.

_is_valid_identifier.description: Returns true if string is a valid identifier.

_string_get_word_breaks.description: Returns an array of the word break boundaries. Elements in the returned array are the offsets of the start and end of words. Therefore the length of the array is always even.

_string_get_character_breaks.description: Returns array of the composite character boundaries.

_is_confusable.description: Returns index of the first string in dict which is visually confusable with the string, or -1 if none is found.

_spoof_check.description: Returns true if string is likely to be an attempt at confusing the reader.

_string_to_upper.description: Returns the string converted to UPPERCASE.

_string_to_lower.description: Returns the string converted to lowercase.

_string_to_title.description: Returns the string converted to Title Case.

_parse_structured_text.description: Default implementation of the BiDi algorithm override function.

_cleanup.description: This method is called before text server is unregistered.

Texture.brief_description: Base class for all texture types.
Texture.description: is the base class for all texture types. Common texture types are  and . See also .

Texture2D.description:
A texture works by registering an image in the video hardware, which then can be used in 3D models or 2D  or GUI .
		Textures are often created by loading them from a file. See @GDScript.load.
		 is a base for other resources. It cannot be used directly.
		Note: The maximum texture size is 16384×16384 pixels due to graphics hardware limitations. Larger textures may fail to import.

Called when the entire  is requested to be drawn over a , with the top-left offset specified in pos. modulate specifies a multiplier for the colors being drawn, while transpose specifies whether drawing should be performed in column-major order instead of row-major order (resulting in 90-degree clockwise rotation).
				Note: This is only used in 2D rendering, not 3D.

Called when the  is requested to be drawn onto 's specified rect. modulate specifies a multiplier for the colors being drawn, while transpose specifies whether drawing should be performed in column-major order instead of row-major order (resulting in 90-degree clockwise rotation).
				Note: This is only used in 2D rendering, not 3D.

_draw_rect_region.description:
Called when a part of the  specified by src_rect's coordinates is requested to be drawn onto 's specified rect. modulate specifies a multiplier for the colors being drawn, while transpose specifies whether drawing should be performed in column-major order instead of row-major order (resulting in 90-degree clockwise rotation).
				Note: This is only used in 2D rendering, not 3D.

Texture2DArray.brief_description: A single texture resource which consists of multiple, separate images. Each image has the same dimensions and number of mipmap levels.
Texture2DArray.description:
A Texture2DArray is different from a Texture3D: The Texture2DArray does not support trilinear interpolation between the s, i.e. no blending. See also  and , which are texture arrays with specialized cubemap functions.
		A Texture2DArray is also different from an : In a Texture2DArray, all images are treated separately. In an atlas, the regions (i.e. the single images) can be of different sizes. Furthermore, you usually need to add a padding around the regions, to prevent accidental UV mapping to more than one region. The same goes for mipmapping: Mipmap chains are handled separately for each layer. In an atlas, the slicing has to be done manually in the fragment shader.
		To create such a texture file yourself, reimport your image files using the Godot Editor import presets. To create a Texture2DArray from code, use ImageTextureLayered.create_from_images on an instance of the Texture2DArray class.

TextureButton.brief_description: Texture-based button. Supports Pressed, Hover, Disabled and Focused states.
TextureButton.description:
has the same functionality as , except it uses sprites instead of Godot's  resource. It is faster to create, but it doesn't support localization like more complex s.
		See also  which contains common properties and methods associated with this node.
		Note: Setting a texture for the "normal" state (texture_normal) is recommended. If texture_normal is not set, the  will still receive input events and be clickable, but the user will not be able to see it unless they activate another one of its states with a texture assigned (e.g., hover over it to show texture_hover).

texture_normal.description: Texture to display by default, when the node is not in the disabled, hover or pressed state. This texture is still displayed in the focused state, with texture_focused drawn on top.

texture_pressed.description: Texture to display on mouse down over the node, if the node has keyboard focus and the player presses the Enter key or if the player presses the BaseButton.shortcut key. If not assigned, the  displays texture_hover instead when pressed.

texture_hover.description: Texture to display when the mouse hovers over the node. If not assigned, the  displays texture_normal instead when hovered over.

texture_disabled.description: Texture to display when the node is disabled. See BaseButton.disabled. If not assigned, the  displays texture_normal instead.

texture_focused.description: Texture to overlay on the base texture when the node has mouse or keyboard focus. Because texture_focused is displayed on top of the base texture, a partially transparent texture should be used to ensure the base texture remains visible. A texture that represents an outline or an underline works well for this purpose. To disable the focus visual effect, assign a fully transparent texture of any size. Note that disabling the focus visual effect will harm keyboard/controller navigation usability, so this is not recommended for accessibility reasons.

texture_click_mask.description: Pure black and white  image to use for click detection. On the mask, white pixels represent the button's clickable area. Use it to create buttons with curved shapes.

ignore_texture_size.description: If true, the size of the texture won't be considered for minimum size calculation, so the  can be shrunk down past the texture size.

stretch_mode.description: Controls the texture's behavior when you resize the node's bounding rectangle. See the  constants for available options.

flip_h.description: If true, texture is flipped horizontally.

flip_v.description: If true, texture is flipped vertically.

Offsets texture_progress if fill_mode is , , or .

nine_patch_stretch.description: If true, Godot treats the bar's textures like in . Use the stretch_margin_* properties like stretch_margin_bottom to set up the nine patch's 3×3 grid. When using a radial fill_mode, this setting will only enable stretching for texture_progress, while texture_under and texture_over will be treated like in .

stretch_margin_top.description: The height of the 9-patch's top row. Only effective if nine_patch_stretch is true.

stretch_margin_right.description: The width of the 9-patch's right column. Only effective if nine_patch_stretch is true.

Theme.brief_description: A resource used for styling/skinning s and s.
Theme.description:
A resource used for styling/skinning  and  nodes. While individual controls can be styled using their local theme overrides (see Control.add_theme_color_override), theme resources allow you to store and apply the same settings across all controls sharing the same type (e.g. style all s the same). One theme resource can be used for the entire project, but you can also set a separate theme resource to a branch of control nodes. A theme resource assigned to a control applies to the control itself, as well as all of its direct and indirect children (as long as a chain of controls is uninterrupted).
		Use ProjectSettings.gui/theme/custom to set up a project-scope theme that will be available to every control in your project.
		Use Control.theme of any control node to set up a theme that will be available to that control and all of its direct and indirect children.

set_icon.description: Creates or changes the value of the icon property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_icon to remove the property.

get_icon.description:

				Returns the engine fallback icon value if the property doesn't exist (see ThemeDB.fallback_icon). Use has_icon to check for existence.

has_icon.description:
Returns true if the icon property defined by name and theme_type exists.
				Returns false if it doesn't exist. Use set_icon to define it.

rename_icon.description:
Renames the icon property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
				Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use has_icon to check for existence, and clear_icon to remove the existing property.

clear_icon.description:
Removes the icon property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
				Fails if it doesn't exist. Use has_icon to check for existence.

get_font.description:
Returns the  property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
				Returns the default theme font if the property doesn't exist and the default theme font is set up (see default_font). Use has_font to check for existence of the property and has_default_font to check for existence of the default theme font.
				Returns the engine fallback font value, if neither exist (see ThemeDB.fallback_font).

has_font.description:
Returns true if the  property defined by name and theme_type exists, or if the default theme font is set up (see has_default_font).
				Returns false if neither exist. Use set_font to define the property.

rename_font.description:
Renames the  property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
				Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use has_font to check for existence, and clear_font to remove the existing property.

clear_font.description:
Removes the  property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
				Fails if it doesn't exist. Use has_font to check for existence.

get_font_list.description: Returns a list of names for  properties defined with theme_type. Use get_font_type_list to get a list of possible theme type names.

get_font_type_list.description: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for  properties. Use get_type_list to get a list of all unique theme types.

set_font_size.description: Creates or changes the value of the font size property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_font_size to remove the property.

get_font_size.description:
Returns the font size property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
				Returns the default theme font size if the property doesn't exist and the default theme font size is set up (see default_font_size). Use has_font_size to check for existence of the property and has_default_font_size to check for existence of the default theme font.
				Returns the engine fallback font size value, if neither exist (see ThemeDB.fallback_font_size).

has_font_size.description:
Returns true if the font size property defined by name and theme_type exists, or if the default theme font size is set up (see has_default_font_size).
				Returns false if neither exist. Use set_font_size to define the property.

rename_font_size.description:
Renames the font size property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
				Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use has_font_size to check for existence, and clear_font_size to remove the existing property.

clear_font_size.description:
Removes the font size property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
				Fails if it doesn't exist. Use has_font_size to check for existence.

get_font_size_list.description: Returns a list of names for font size properties defined with theme_type. Use get_font_size_type_list to get a list of possible theme type names.

get_font_size_type_list.description: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for font size properties. Use get_type_list to get a list of all unique theme types.

set_color.description: Creates or changes the value of the  property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_color to remove the property.

get_color.description:
Returns the  property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
				Returns the default color value if the property doesn't exist. Use has_color to check for existence.

has_color.description:
Returns true if the  property defined by name and theme_type exists.
				Returns false if it doesn't exist. Use set_color to define it.

rename_color.description:
Renames the  property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
				Fails if it doesn't exist, or if a similar property with the new name already exists. Use has_color to check for existence, and clear_color to remove the existing property.

clear_color.description:
Removes the  property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
				Fails if it doesn't exist. Use has_color to check for existence.

get_color_list.description: Returns a list of names for  properties defined with theme_type. Use get_color_type_list to get a list of possible theme type names.

get_color_type_list.description: Returns a list of all unique theme type names for  properties. Use get_type_list to get a list of all unique theme types.

set_constant.description: Creates or changes the value of the constant property defined by name and theme_type. Use clear_constant to remove the property.

get_constant.description:
Returns the constant property defined by name and theme_type, if it exists.
				Returns 0 if the property doesn't exist. Use has_constant to check for existence.

has_constant.description:
Returns true if the constant property defined by name and theme_type exists.
				Returns false if it doesn't exist. Use set_constant to define it.

rename_constant.description:
Renames the constant property defined by old_name and theme_type to name, if it exists.
